At Medtronic, we value what makes you unique. Be part of a company that thinks differently to solve problems, make progress, and deliver meaningful innovations.

Our Purpose

At Medtronic Patient Care Systems (PCS), we power the digital heartbeat behind life-saving cardiac therapies. We build the connected ecosystem that enables clinicians to monitor, manage, and protect millions of patients living with implantable cardiac devices around the world.

From secure device connectivity and real-time data platforms to intelligent clinical tools and patient-facing experiences, PCS transforms complex cardiac data into clarity, helping physicians make faster decisions, improving outcomes, and giving patients greater confidence in their care.

Every line of code we write supports someone’s parent, spouse, child, or friend. Our work ensures that life-saving therapies are not only delivered safely and reliably, but continuously improved through innovation, insight, and global scale.

If you want to build technology that truly matters, where uptime means peace of mind and innovation means more birthdays, join us. Together, we are shaping the future of connected cardiac care and changing lives every single day

Come for a job, stay for a career!

A Day in The Life Of:

As Product Director you will help shape and deliver the next generation of connected patient-care products and experiences.

This role will operate across a portfolio that includes patient-facing digital products, mobile applications, connected devices, embedded software, platform capabilities, cloud services, data, and AI-enabled experiences. The Product Director will define product direction, lead through discovery and execution, and help create products intended for patients and healthcare systems around the world.

This is a hands-on product leadership role for someone who can move comfortably between long-term strategy and near-term execution, customer needs and technical trade-offs, and product vision and measurable results. The Product Director will also be a leader in building the Product Management footprint in Galway, including product practices, operating mechanisms, partnerships, and talent.

The role reflects the expectation that Product Management owns the problem and the outcome, leads through discovery, runs products with strong business judgment, and develops the product craft and the people around it.

No two days will be exactly alike. A day may include speaking with patients or clinicians, reviewing product and operational data, shaping a multi-year product direction, working with engineers on mobile or embedded-software trade-offs, evaluating an AI-enabled opportunity, or helping leaders make an investment decision.

Other days may focus on discovery reviews, roadmap choices, product quality, global-market needs, release readiness, or developing the Galway product organization. Throughout the work, the Product Director connects customer needs, business goals, technical possibilities, organizational capacity, and measurable outcomes into a coherent direction.

Key Responsibilities:

Define and communicate a clear product vision, strategy, outcome-based roadmaps, and measurable goals for connected patient-care products and platform capabilities.

Translate patient, clinical, customer, technical, and business needs into prioritized opportunities and clear direction for Engineering and Design.

Own product outcomes across the lifecycle, from discovery and business-case development through launch readiness, adoption, performance measurement, lifecycle decisions, and continuous improvement.

Lead cross-functional product development across mobile, embedded software, cloud, connected devices, platform services, data, AI, cybersecurity, clinical, regulatory, quality, commercial, and operations teams.

Balance patient experience, safety, clinical and scientific rigor, security, privacy, regulatory requirements, technical feasibility, lifecycle needs, cost, and business value when making decisions.

Use customer research, field feedback, product analytics, experimentation, operational evidence, and market insight to identify unmet needs and guide investment.

Define success measures for quality, reliability, adoption, customer trust, patient and clinician value, and economic impact.

Evaluate AI-enabled product opportunities and technical trade-offs, including output quality, explainability, latency, cost, safety, security, privacy, and responsible use.

Build alignment across global stakeholders, communicate decisions and risks clearly, and create momentum in complex environments without relying on direct authority.

Help establish Galway as a durable product leadership centre capable of owning meaningful global outcomes and developing future Product Management talent.

Required Qualifications:

Requires an Honours Bachelor’s degree and minimum of 10 years of product management, Product Leadership, or equivalent experience.

Demonstrated experience owning product strategy, roadmaps, priorities, investment decisions, and measurable outcomes for complex products or portfolios.

Experience leading highly technical, cross-functional initiatives in a global or matrixed organization.

Strong customer-discovery, analytical, product-judgment, and business-case development skills.

Technical fluency across software, mobile applications, cloud platforms, APIs, connected devices, embedded systems, data products, AI/ML, or related technologies.

Hands-on experience using AI-assisted tools and workflows as part of daily Product Management practice, including customer research, synthesis, analysis, roadmap development, requirements definition, communication, experimentation, and decision support.

Ability to identify and evaluate AI-enabled product opportunities while considering customer value, quality, explainability, risk, cost, privacy, security, and responsible use.

Ability to translate complex customer, clinical, technical, and business information into clear product choices and executable priorities.

Proven ability to influence across organizations, create structure in ambiguity, and communicate effectively with technical, clinical, business, and executive audiences.

Experience developing people, building team capability, or establishing product-management practices and operating mechanisms.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience operating within global regulatory and quality frameworks (FDA, EU MDR, ISO 13485), including leading design reviews, risk assessments, and audit interactions.

Demonstrated track record embedding cybersecurity, privacy, reliability, and safety-by-design principles into product architecture and backlog decisions.

Experience in healthcare, medical devices, digital health, patient monitoring, connected devices, or another regulated and safety-critical industry.· Experience with patient-facing mobile applications and embedded-software or connected-device ecosystems.

Experience with identity and access, data interoperability, analytics, developer platforms, sensing, or global platform capabilities.

Experience managing product modernization, lifecycle decisions, technical debt, or global phase-in and phase-out decisions.

This position requires a strong team player who is a self-starter, inquisitive, and a fast learner. This role will be pivotal in ensuring the development of medical devices that drive successful design transfer.

Key Responsibilities:

Supplier selection and qualification while ensuring suppliers deliver quality parts, materials, and services.

Monitor parts from acquisition through the manufacturing cycle, promptly identifying and resolving supplier-related problems.

Evaluate supplier technical and manufacturing capabilities to meet product, process, quality, and business requirements as an input to supplier selection.

Manage Non-Conformance Material Reports (NCMRs) for material, components and production related issues, ensuring trends are identified, analyzed, and addressed across incoming, production, and sterilization areas.

Manage suppliers' change requests, including communication, project management, and regular reporting.

Manage the Approved Supplier List, from supplier evaluation, supplier agreement, supplier audits to supplier acceptance.

Qualify materials through the Production Part Approval Process (PPAP), including process validation, test method validation, technical writing, and project management.

Drive supplier performance improvement and reduce escapes to manufacturing through effective issue escalation, Supplier CAPA management, and Quality Performance Reviews.

Oversee Process validation (IQ/OQ/PQ) and Master Validation Planning in new product development.

Perform Statistical analysis of manufacturing process performance outputs

Oversee Process Failure Mode and Effect Analysis (internally and externally)

Collaborate cross functionally to ensure process limitations are captured within the design control, including Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis and Design for Manufacturability and Assembly activities.

Collaborate cross functionally to ensure essential components, product features and respective process controls are identified.

Ensure Design Transfer effectively translates design specifications into production specifications.

Use project management skills to ensure that supplier processes are developing at the appropriate cadence to support engineering builds and Design Verification and Validation.

The job requires occasional travel to visit suppliers within the United States and internationally.

Education: Minimum bachelor’s degree in engineering, or a related technical field AND minimum 4 years of relevant experience. OR advanced degree with a minimum of 2 years relevant experience.

Technical Knowledge: Extensive understanding of manufacturing processes for plastics, metals, electronics and/or product level assembly. Extensive understanding of GD&T, FMEA, DFX principles.

Regulatory Knowledge: Extensive experience in a regulated environment.

Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to conduct thorough root cause analysis.

Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and present complex information to stakeholders.

Leadership: Proven leadership and project management skills with the ability to lead teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Preferred Qualifications:

Certifications: Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), Six Sigma Green Belt or equivalent certification, AAMI design control certification is preferred.

Regulatory Knowledge: In-depth knowledge of FDA regulations, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, and other relevant standards.

Technical Skills: Proficient in quality management systems, risk management, regulatory compliance, and statistics. Lead auditor experience.

Other: Basic knowledge of human anatomy/physiology and surgical procedures

Experience with vulnerability assessment, penetration testing, static analysis, dynamic analysis, or application security testing methodologies.

Experience securing medical devices, healthcare technologies, embedded systems, Internet of Things (IoT) devices, or cloud-connected products.

Knowledge of IEC 81001-5-1, IEC 60601-4-5, ISO 14971, FDA cybersecurity guidance, and National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) cybersecurity frameworks.

Experience with secure boot, cryptography, authentication, authorization, access management, secure communications, data protection, and secure software update mechanisms.

Experience supporting cybersecurity activities within regulated healthcare, life sciences, or medical technology environments.

Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Global Information Assurance Certification (GIAC), Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH), or similar cybersecurity certification.

Strategic Leadership and Planning:

Lead the development, communication, and execution of the OT cybersecurity strategy for manufacturing and distribution environments, ensuring linkage to Medtronic’s enterprise strategy, business objectives, and risk priorities.

Translate strategy into operational plans, roadmaps, standards, and measurable business outcomes across multiple OT security job areas and site operations.

Recommend strategies, goals, priorities, and resource plans for the OT cybersecurity function, balancing business continuity, resilience, compliance, and risk reduction.

Partner with senior leaders across manufacturing, engineering, quality, supply chain, and enterprise cybersecurity to integrate OT security into business and operational decisions.

Lead, coach, and develop experienced professionals, site security champions, and/or people or program leaders; set clear performance expectations and build organizational capability.

Establish, implement, and continuously improve OT cybersecurity policies, standards, controls, and governance mechanisms aligned to business needs and industry expectations.

Initiate programs and projects based on identified business, operational, and tactical needs to improve cyber resilience, consistency, and compliance across sites.

Evaluate, prioritize, and drive adoption of security technologies, operational capabilities, and process improvements that significantly improve OT security effectiveness and scalability.

Develop new objectives, operating procedures, standards, and cross-site practices that address complex, undefined security challenges and enable knowledge sharing and best practices across the business area.

Communicate and present OT security risks, strategy, program health, and business impacts to technical teams, business leaders, and senior leadership.

As a Software Engineer – UI/UX (Qt/QML) You will own significant features and workflows in the Prism Mapping application UI — the surfaces clinicians use during procedures and case review. A typical week mixes deep Qt/QML and C++/Python implementation, partnership with UX designers translating Figma designs into responsive production interfaces, integration work with the visualization, signals, and infrastructure teams, and the kind of debugging that happens when application state, real-time data, and human interaction all collide. The Affera Prism Mapping System is an advanced electrophysiology mapping platform used by physicians to diagnose and guide the treatment of cardiac arrhythmias. It captures and processes signals from inside the beating heart, builds detailed real-time three-dimensional maps of cardiac anatomy and electrical activity, and presents that information to clinicians and mapping specialists during live procedures. Engineers on this team build the software that makes that possible — from the runtime and data pipelines that move signals in milliseconds, to the algorithms that turn raw signals into clinically meaningful information, to the visualization and UI surfaces clinicians rely on in the lab.

The Cranial & Spinal Technologies (CST) operating unit partners with healthcare professionals to advance spine and cranial surgery through spinal implants, enabling technologies, navigation, and robotics. Within CST, this role sits in the Spine business and is responsible for driving sales growth and clinical adoption of a market-leading spine portfolio across a defined Queensland territory.
Based in Brisbane, Queensland, the Territory Manager supports customers across the Brisbane metropolitan region, including major public and private hospitals. The position offers a flexible work arrangement, with time spent across customer sites, operating theatres, and home-based administrative activities. Regular travel throughout the assigned territory is required, along with occasional attendance at training programs, customer education events, and after-hours clinical support activities.

As a Territory Manager, you will be responsible for growing the Spine portfolio across a defined territory while providing clinical and technical support to surgeons and healthcare teams. This role combines sales execution, customer relationship management, case support, and product education to drive adoption of spine technologies and support positive patient outcomes.
Primary Responsibilities

Develop and execute territory plans to achieve sales targets and expand market share within the Spine portfolio.

Build relationships with spine surgeons, neurosurgeons, orthopaedic surgeons, nursing leaders, theatre teams, and hospital decision-makers.

Provide clinical support and technical expertise during surgical procedures and product evaluations.

Deliver product training, in-services, and education programs for surgeons, registrars, nurses, radiology teams, and other healthcare professionals.

Drive adoption of new spine technologies through customer engagement, clinical evidence, and solution-based selling.

Manage sales opportunities, quotations, forecasting, and customer follow-up activities across the territory.

Gather and communicate market intelligence, customer insights, and competitive information.

Maintain advanced product knowledge and collaborate with cross-functional teams to support business objectives.

Required Qualifications

High School Diploma and 8+ years' relevant sales or clinical experience OR Associate's Degree and 6+ years' relevant sales or clinical experience OR Bachelor's Degree and 4+ years' relevant sales or clinical experience.

Experience within spinal implants, neurosurgery, orthopaedics, or other surgical-focused medical device portfolios.

Experience supporting surgical procedures and delivering technical product training and customer education.

Ability to travel throughout the assigned territory and attend customer meetings, training events, and conferences.

Valid driver's licence.

Bachelor's degree in Biomedical Engineering.

Minimum 2 years' experience in the Spine market.

Experience working with surgeons and operating theatre teams to support technology adoption and procedural success.

Position Description:

Principal Manufacturing Engineer for Medtronic, Inc. in Jacksonville, FL. Responsible for coordinating and executing the Medtronic site Verification and Validation (V&V) deliverables, for supplier transfers within the Supplier Optimization group (Transfer Office) under the Operations Innovation team. Assist with defining Quality Impact Level (QIL) of supplier qualified product. Design assembly and holding fixtures, coordinate supplier fabrication, and develop protocols, reports, process instructions, preventive maintenance plans, and calibration schedules. Navigate the complexities of various government and industry regulations to include FDA 21 CFR part 820, European Union Medical Device Regulation (EU MDR), ISO 13485, ISO 14971, and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP). Responsible for the PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) for supplier provided goods. Leverage IQ (Installation Qualification), OQ (Operational Qualification), and PQ (Performance Qualification). Utilize Minitab and associated statistical tools including TMV (Test Method Validation), Capability (Ppk / Tolerance Intervals), and SPC (Statistical Process Control). Responsible for providing Control Plans, Process Flow Maps, and PFMEA (Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis). Coordinate the creation and approval of V&V protocols / reports to include top-level assembly or sub-assembly test acceptance criteria, sample sizes based on component/feature criticality, and sampling plans. Leverage AGILE, SAP, and ERP system knowledge based on Medtronic Operating Unit/site requirements. Execute First Article Inspection activities and summation of results. Update all BOM (Bill of Material) structure within the appropriate QMS (Quality Mgmt. System). Relocation assistance is not available for this position. #LI-DNI.

Basic Qualifications:

Masters’ Degree in Mechanical, Industrial, or Biomedical Engineering or related engineering field and five (5) years of experience as a manufacturing or design engineer for medical devices,

or,

Bachelors’ Degree in Mechanical, Industrial, or Biomedical Engineering or related engineering field and seven (7) years of experience as a manufacturing or design engineer for medical devices.

Must possess at least five (5) years’ experience with each of the following:

FDA 21 CFR part 820, EU MDR, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, and GMP; PPAP and IQ/OQ/PQ; Minitab, TMV, Capability (Ppk / Tolerance Intervals), and SPC; Control Plan, Process Flow Map, and PFMEA; Creation and approval of V&V protocols, reports for top-level assembly and sub-assembly test acceptance criteria, sample sizes based on component/feature criticality, and sampling plans; AGILE, SAP, and ERP systems; Executing First Article Inspection activities and summation of results; and Updating BOM structure within QMS.

Salary: $144,000 to $184,800 per year

work 20+ hours per week: Health, Dental and vision insurance, Health Savings Account, Healthcare Flexible Spending Account, Life insurance, Long-term disability leave, Dependent daycare spending account, Tuition assistance/reimbursement, and Simple Steps (global well-being program). The following benefits and additional compensation are available to all regular employees: Incentive plans, 401(k) plan plus employer contribution and match, Short-term disability, Paid time off, Paid holidays, Employee Stock Purchase Plan, Employee Assistance Program, Non-qualified Retirement Plan Supplement (subject to IRS earning minimums), and Capital Accumulation Plan (available to Vice Presidents and above, or subject to IRS earning minimums).

Join our Medtronic Order Operations team and help redefine how medical technology reaches patients across Western Europe. In our evolving Specialized Services environment, you will drive operational excellence, improve process quality, and directly support our Mission to patients.

Customer Care is evolving into a specialist organization where operational excellence, process expertise and continuous improvement come together to create greater value for patients, customers and business partners.

You combine deep operational knowledge with analytical thinking and continuous improvement methodologies to strengthen end-to-end Offer-to-Cash processes across our Spinal and Aortic Operating Units.

Working closely with Operating Units, Sales, Customer Care Shared Service Centers, Supply Chain, Finance, Logistics and Quality, you act as a trusted operational partner and subject matter expert, translating business needs into scalable operational solutions and sustainable process improvements. Through strong stakeholder partnerships, you influence operational performance, simplify complex workflows and improve process governance across multiple EMEA countries.

Beyond operational excellence, you play a key role in shaping the future operating model by driving standardization, digitalization, automation, AI-enabled workflows and self-service adoption. Your expertise helps transform operational insights into sustainable solutions that strengthen customer experience, operational performance and organizational capability.

If you enjoy solving complex operational challenges, influencing strategic improvements without formal authority and helping shape the future of Customer Care, this role offers an exciting opportunity to make a meaningful impact within a highly international environment.

As a Process Excellence Specialist, you provide specialist expertise across assigned Offer-to-Cash process domains, ensuring operational stability, process governance and continuous improvement across multiple EMEA countries.

Your day combines operational monitoring, analytical problem solving, stakeholder partnership and continuous improvement. You monitor process performance and KPI trends, investigate complex operational issues, distinguish root causes from symptoms and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to implement sustainable improvements.

Using your expertise in SAP, operational workflows and end-to-end Order-to-Cash processes, you identify opportunities to standardize processes, reduce variation and improve operational performance. You support governance by maintaining process documentation, strengthening knowledge management and ensuring consistent process execution across the organization.

You build trusted relationships with Operating Units, Sales and internal stakeholders by acting as a strategic operational partner. Rather than simply resolving today's issues, you identify recurring themes, challenge existing ways of working and translate operational insights into long-term improvements that create value for both the business and our customers.

You continuously anticipate future operational needs by identifying opportunities to strengthen digital capabilities, improve process maturity and increase touchless execution across the customer journey.

Beyond daily operations, you actively shape the future of Customer Care by identifying opportunities for automation, AI-enabled workflows and touchless processing. You promote self-service adoption, coach colleagues on standardized processes and contribute specialist expertise that enables a more scalable, efficient and future-ready organization.

Act as the recognized subject matter expert for assigned Offer-to-Cash process domains across multiple EMEA countries.

Monitor operational performance, workflows and KPI trends to proactively identify risks, bottlenecks and improvement opportunities.

Analyze complex operational issues, distinguish root causes from symptoms and implement sustainable improvements using Lean Six Sigma and DMAIC methodologies.

Develop and maintain expert knowledge of end-to-end Offer-to-Cash processes, SAP, Customer Interaction Center (CIC) and support operational systems.

Drive process governance, standardization and operational excellence by developing and maintaining process documentation, work instructions and knowledge management.

Build trusted partnerships with Operating Units, Sales, Customer Care Shared Service Centers and enabling functions, acting as a strategic operational advisor for assigned process domains.

Translate operational insights and stakeholder feedback into scalable process improvements, automation opportunities and future AI-enabled solutions.

Lead or contribute to cross-functional strategic initiatives and transformation projects that strengthen operational excellence, customer experience and future organizational capability.

Represent the function in regional projects, governance forums and business discussions as the recognized subject matter expert for assigned process domains.

Promote the adoption of digital solutions, self-service capabilities and automation by coaching stakeholders towards the most effective and standardized ways of working.

Influence operational decisions through specialist expertise, data analysis and evidence-based recommendations while effectively working without formal authority.

Coach colleagues share specialist knowledge and strengthen organizational capability through collaboration, knowledge transfer and continuous learning.

Promote a culture of operational excellence, innovation, ownership and continuous improvement.

Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

At Medtronic, our ASICs contribute to human welfare by restoring health and extending life; it's part of our Mission. This means our designers need to understand and participate in the big picture of how their work impacts the end user, a patient. Opportunities to meet doctors and witness implants directly connect our work to patient outcomes and lives.

Our team is working on Medtronic's next generation of Cardiac Rhythm Management (CRM) products, supported by our designers through roles including requirements definition, design exploration and implementation, simulation analysis, circuit evaluation and verification, physical design, lab testing supporting characterization and formal verification, production test, and other tasks in the development of implantable cardiac devices.

At Medtronic, we bring bold ideas forward with speed and decisiveness to put patients first in everything we do. In-person exchanges are invaluable to our work. We’re working a minimum of 4 days a week onsite as part of our commitment to fostering a culture of professional growth and cross-functional collaboration as we work together to engineer the extraordinary.

We are seeking a Principal IC Design Engineer - Analog to help lead the development of next generation Cardiac Rhythm Management devices.

Role and Responsibilities

Specify, develop and design analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits as individual contributor and through coaching of peer and less-experienced teammates.

Define direction for circuit innovation and changes through gathering and reduction of requirements or needs from product, project, systems, test, research, or firmware engineering.

Foster communication and collaboration across team and supporting departments.

Take ownership and responsibility for design(s) through entire development cycle from concept through release to production.

Create schematics and verification simulations within Cadence EDA tools

Integrate test strategy into design for highly testable ICs or built-in self-test architectures.

Integrate designs into Mixed-Signal, AMS, modeling simulations supporting chip-level verification.

Translate circuit requirements into layout directions that drive signal integrity, matching, thermal, etc.

Direct and review IC layout activities within Cadence Layout tools.

Create parasitic extraction of physical design and perform impact analysis.

Specify, direct and perform design characterization and verification of ICs and electronic modules.

Develop, configure, and run complex characterization tests using test and measurement equipment and other lab tools including LabView and Python for automation.

Conduct concept, preliminary, critical and fracture reviews to ensure device quality, capability and functional requirements.

Review EDA tool vendor offerings with focus on improving existing processes or methods.

BS in Electrical or Electronic Engineering or related field with minimum 7 years of experience designing analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits

Or minimum 3 years of experience designing analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits with a PhD

MS in Electrical or Electronics Engineering.

Experience using Cadence EDA analog and mixed-signal tools.

A thorough knowledge of analog and mixed-signal IC design methodologies.

Demonstrated experience navigating multi-variable tradeoff considerations typical of analog designs with ability to coach others on the same.

Ultra-Low power and subthreshold design methodologies.

Thorough knowledge of semiconductor materials, devices, and fabrication.

Experience with high-voltage and switch-mode power electronic devices and applications.

Expertise in Cadence analog design tools.

Expertise with quality and statistical methods.

Medical Device experience preferred.

As we are building our new in-house Service & Repair Customer Care organization, we are looking for Customer Care Specialists who are passionate about delivering exceptional services and who thrive in a fast-moving environment.

This role is ideal for professionals who enjoy solving complex customer challenges, driving operational excellence, and helping teams succeed. While you will contribute to projects, process improvements, and system enhancements, you will also remain closely connected to day-to-day customer care operations and customer interactions. Your work will directly support healthcare providers and ultimately contribute to patient care.

We are looking for experienced professionals who combine strong operational expertise with a passion for continuous improvement and customer excellence.

This position follows a hybrid work arrangement, with a combination of office-based and remote work. Travel is expected to be minimal and primarily associated with business meetings, training, or organizational initiatives.
As a Customer Care Specialist, you will combine advanced customer operations expertise with a focus on operational excellence and continuous improvement. You will support complex customer situations, drive process enhancements, provide operational guidance, and contribute to projects and business initiatives while remaining actively involved in day-to-day customer care activities.

Primary Responsibilities

Act as a subject matter expert for complex customer inquiries, operational processes, and escalated issues

Manage customer transactions, quotations, orders, and follow-up activities while ensuring operational accuracy and quality

Partner with internal stakeholders to resolve complex customer and operational matters

Identify opportunities to improve processes, simplify workflows, and implement sustainable solutions

Participate in projects, system implementations, business initiatives, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities

Support compliance with company policies, procedures, and quality requirements

Analyze operational data and performance trends to identify opportunities for improvement

Support knowledge-sharing, onboarding, and training activities across the Customer Care team

Required Qualifications

High School Diploma with 4+ years, or Associate's Degree with 2+ years, or Bachelor's Degree with 1+ year of experience in customer service, customer operations, service support, or a related environment

Professional proficiency in English and French both written and verbal

Experience managing complex customer situations, escalations, or cross-functional operational processes

Experience analyzing operational data and applying insights to support improvements.

Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Excel, and Word

Experience supporting customers within healthcare, medical technology, life sciences, manufacturing, or other regulated industries

Experience using Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) or Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems such as SAP or Salesforce

Proficiency in additional languages

Experience participating in projects, business transformation initiatives, or system implementations

Experience supporting continuous improvement or operational excellence initiatives

job_description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. A Day in the Life
The Sr. Business Manager, ICT EMEA Region-led markets is responsible for driving business growth, commercial execution, and strategic marketing initiatives across RLMs ACEE and TURMECA. This role partners closely with regional/ country commercial leaders and teams, and global ICT OU to accelerate the adoption of SH, Coronary, and Renal Denervation therapies in the region.
Key responsibilities include strategic business planning and forecasting, product launch planning & execution, market development, physician engagement, and cross-functional collaboration to deliver sustainable growth and achieve the ICT business’s regional financial objectives. The role also helps expand access to our therapies for more physicians and patients across the EMEA RLM while supporting consistent, high-quality, and safe patient outcomes.

This position is required to support the continued growth of the Interventional Cardiology Therapies (ICT) business across Region-Led Markets (RLMs). As ICT expands across Structural Heart, Coronary, and Renal Denervation therapies, dedicated regional resources are needed to drive commercial execution, business planning, market development, and alignment between country teams and global operating units.
The role will help accelerate growth opportunities, improve visibility to business performance, support new product launches, and ensure consistent execution of regional priorities, ultimately contributing to the achievement of financial and strategic objectives across the region.

Primary Responsibilities:

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:

Partner with regional and country leadership to identify growth opportunities, market-development priorities, investment needs, and business risks. Develop and execute the EMEA RLM ICT business strategy across Structural Heart, Coronary, and Renal Denervation

Translate global portfolio and therapy strategies into actionable regional and country-level plans by partnering closely with the EMEA RLM SME team and commercial teams

Monitor business performance, market dynamics, competitive activity, and key performance indicators, lead and support ICT related planning and forecasting, performance reviews in collaboration with commercial and finance teams

Drive commercial excellence across product launches, therapy-development initiatives, market-access programs, and customer-engagement strategies

Coordinate cross-functional teams—including marketing, sales, medical affairs, clinical, market access, finance, regulatory, supply chain, and operations—to advance regional priorities

Build strong relationships with key regional advocates and internal stakeholders to understand unmet needs and identify opportunities for growth

Support the development and engagement of regional key opinion leaders and centers of excellence

Partner closely with business leaders from other Cardiovascular OUs across the EMEA RLM to align strategies, share market insights, and identify opportunities for collaboration

Promote coordinated execution and mutual value across Cardiovascular businesses while maintaining clear accountability for ICT priorities and performance

Facilitate best-practice sharing and collaboration across TURMECA, ACEE, other Region-Led Markets, and global OU

Develop business cases and resource-allocation recommendations for strategic investments and new growth initiatives

Lead, coach, and develop a geographically dispersed team, fostering accountability, collaboration, inclusion, and high performance

Represent the EMEA RLM perspective in global ICT forums and ensure regional customer and business needs are incorporated into global strategies.

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree with a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience, including at least 5 years of people-management experience; or an advanced degree with a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience, including at least 5 years of people-management experience

Demonstrated experience in business management, marketing, commercial strategy, or market development within the medical devices and healthcare industry

Experience leading cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in a complex matrix organization

Strong business and financial acumen, with experience in strategic planning, forecasting, business-case development, resource allocation, and performance management

Fluency in English is required; proficiency in Arabic is preferred

Ability to travel internationally as required.

Preferred Qualifications:

Proven ability to translate strategy into execution and influence stakeholders across different functions, businesses, geographies, and cultures

Strong analytical, communication, and executive presentation skills

Ability to manage multiple portfolios and priorities across complex and diverse markets.

job_description:

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life
Leading customer-facing healthcare implementations, the Sr. Project Manager is accountable for coordinating internal and external stakeholders, applying the Integrated Solution Delivery Model, and delivering successful outcomes across hardware and software deployments in acute care hospitals.

The role combines project management, technical knowledge, business judgment, and customer engagement.
• Project delivery leadership: The role manages project scope, schedules, communications, documentation, workstreams, milestones, training, execution, and go-live activities while coordinating cross-regional teams and serving as the primary client liaison.
• Risk and issue control: Responsibilities include managing scope, cost, schedule, and measurable outcomes; identifying and resolving issues promptly; minimizing disruption; and escalating critical risks to leadership for timely intervention.
• Lifecycle and compliance improvement: The Sr. Project Manager oversees projects from intake through closure, follows Implementation Services practices, supports continuous improvement in service delivery, and ensures compliance with corporate, information technology, customer-specific, and Medtronic standards.
• Experience and capabilities: Candidates are expected to demonstrate leadership, executive-level communication, organizational discipline, cross-functional influence, strategic judgment, and the ability to oversee infrastructure deployment, cloud migration, security enhancements, system administration, virtualization, and secure networking. A bachelor’s degree is required, advanced education is preferred, PMP or equivalent certification is preferred, and at least 5 years of direct Healthcare IT or SaaS project management and implementation experience is required.

The Sr. Project Manager serves as the primary point of accountability for both internal and external stakeholders across a range of customer-facing projects within Acute Care & Monitoring. This role is responsible for leading the application of the Integrated Solution Delivery Model to ensure successful healthcare implementation outcomes.

Drawing on a strong foundation in project management, technical expertise, and business acumen, the Sr. Project Manager will guide and influence cross-functional teams and healthcare stakeholders such as technical network infrastructure teams, clinical engineering, hospital operations and facility leaders. They will champion best practices, foster effective communication, and drive high levels of customer adoption and solution success. This role requires a IT foundational skillset that will leverage your experience in the areas of device set up, configuration and deployment of both hardware and software-based products. Our customers are typically acute care hospitals, and the users of our medical devices are in patient care units. Our Digital Health products are both software and hardware-based technologies typically leveraging in place hospital infrastructure.

Throughout each implementation, the Sr. Project Manager will collaborate closely with internal clinical and technical leads, service engineers, leadership, and external clinical and technical partners to coordinate and execute all activities critical to project success.

Project Management Leadership and Accountability

Holds full accountability for the successful delivery of customer outcomes by applying best practices in project organization, stakeholder engagement, benefits realization, risk and issue management, planning and control, change management, and quality assurance.

Oversees the operational execution of assigned projects, acting as the primary liaison among external clients, internal project teams, sales, clinical product specialists, and line management.

Leads and coordinates one or more cross-regional project teams, ensuring alignment and progress across all workstreams.

Lead customer IT and clinical workstream meetings in partnership with our engineers and customer success managers as a subject matter expert with our suite of medical device and software offerings

Serves as the main point of contact for external clients, managing project scope, scheduling and facilitating communications, coordinating clinical and technical requirements, and guiding the project through planning, training, execution, and go-live phases.

Provides strategic technical and analytical insights to leadership and governance bodies to support informed decision-making.

Ensures all project documentation is properly maintained, stored, and shared with relevant team members to support ongoing customer needs.

Develops and maintains comprehensive project plans, meeting documentation, and progress reports to track all technical and clinical project activities.

Monitors project performance using defined metrics and tools to ensure alignment with goals and timelines.

Facilitates collaboration across internal and external clinical and technical teams, ensuring all requirements and outcomes are documented and met.

Communicates significant project impacts and account health updates to internal and external stakeholders in a timely and transparent manner.

Leads and facilitates project kick-offs and milestone meetings, both onsite and remotely, in accordance with established methodologies.

Ensures the completion and proper archiving of all project deliverables and documentation in approved repositories.

Risk Mitigation and Issue Resolution

Proactively manages risks across all project dimensions to minimize disruptions and ensure strong customer adoption.

Maintains control over project constraints: scope, cost, schedule, and measurable outcomes to ensure successful delivery.

Identifies and resolves project issues promptly to meet productivity, quality, and client satisfaction goals.

Escalates critical risks and issues to leadership as appropriate, ensuring transparency and timely intervention.

Operational Improvements

Stays current with advancements in project management methodologies and contributes to the continuous improvement of service delivery practices.

Oversees all phases of the project lifecycle—from intake through implementation and closure; ensuring alignment with Implementation Services best practices and policies.

Ensures full compliance with all corporate, IT, and customer-specific policies and standards, including those of Medtronic.

Differentiating Factors

Autonomy: Operates independently with minimal supervision, determining strategic approaches to complex challenges. Provides coaching and oversight to junior team members and may lead projects or processes.

Organizational Impact: Drives the success of entire projects or processes, building consensus and fostering collaboration to meet team and organizational objectives.

Innovation and Complexity: Tackles complex, multi-dimensional problems requiring deep understanding across domains. Recommends and implements process, system, or product improvements to enhance performance. Balances strategic vision with tactical execution.

Communication and Influence: Engages with C-suite executives, senior leaders, clients, vendors, and partners. Communicates critical updates, negotiates outcomes, and influences decision-making through briefings and strategic dialogue.

Professional Requirements

Demonstrates strong leadership and accountability for project outcomes.

PMP or equivalent industry certification preferred.

Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively at all organizational levels, including executive leadership.

Capable of managing multiple complex projects while aligning with broader organizational goals.

Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities.

Skilled in influencing cross-functional and external teams toward shared goals.

Recognizes when to escalate issues and engage governance structures.

Offers strategic insights and recommendations to support diverse stakeholder needs.

Operates with urgency and a results-driven mindset.

Understands stakeholder roles and resource alignment within project teams.

Willing to travel occasionally for strategic and complex customer engagements.

Ability to oversee technical projects involving infrastructure deployment, cloud migration, and security enhancements. Experience with system administration, virtualization, and secure networking to manage cross-functional teams, coordinate IT implementations, and ensure compliance with industry standards.

Qualifications & Experience

Education: Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred.

Experience: Minimum of 7 years of direct experience in Healthcare IT or SaaS project management and implementation, either as a vendor or in a related consulting role.

For Baccalaureate degrees earned outside of the United States, a degree that satisfies the requirements of 8 C.F.R. § 214.2(h)(4)(iii)(A) is required.

The Sr. Reliability Engineer supports the quality and reliability of advanced stapling technologies throughout the product lifecycle, leading activities ranging from risk assessments and design changes to failure investigations and reliability improvements.

Experience supporting embedded software, electronic hardware, circuit board-based, or electromechanical products.

Experience conducting root cause investigations and resolving product or process quality issues.

Experience applying statistical methods to product, reliability, quality, or process improvement activities.

A Day in the Life
This is an exciting opportunity for a high potential, analytical, pro-active candidate to join the Cardiovascular Strategic Pricing Team. This person, reporting to the Senior Pricing Strategy Manager Cardiovascular EurAsia, acts as the liaison between the Marketing and Offer Development teams for Pricing responsibilities including creation of new product pricing, scenario modeling and financial analysis. The individual will also provide guidance to Marketing on fine tuning new product pricing strategies, implementation of Marketing promotions and tracking price volume initiatives. With in-depth knowledge and understanding of company products, pricing programs and market trends, the individual will help to establish strategic pricing processes, procedures as well as pricing analytic models and drive decision making discussions in the best interest of Medtronic as well as own portfolio projects protecting the value proposition of our products .This person will interact with Marketing, Shared Services, Legal, Sales, Finance and Offer Development team members during the pricing development process.

In return, we will provide you with world-class training, development opportunities and the opportunity to work in a varied and challenging role. Our offer package will include a competitive salary and other great benefits. For this role, you can be located in Istanbul, Johannesburg, Kazakhstan, Prague, Warsaw, Bucharest or Bratislava; responsible for Cardiovascular Business in whole region.

Primary responsibilities:

Lead the development and evolution of strategic pricing frameworks across the sub-region, ensuring alignment with long-term business objectives, portfolio dynamics, and market realities.

Act as a business partner to sub-regional leadership, marketing, and commercial teams, providing strategic guidance on pricing roadmap development, value-based segmentation, and market access readiness.

Shape pricing strategies for new product launches and commercial models by translating procedural trends, competitive insights, and economic value drivers into clear, sustainable pricing direction.

Guide the integration of strategic pricing decisions into planning cycles, business cases, and lifecycle management, helping drive sustainable profitability and market growth.

Own the pricing input into the Integrated Business Planning (IBP) cycle, including ASP planning across portfolios.

Collaborate with regional and global stakeholders to localize pricing governance frameworks, build pricing capabilities, and ensure consistency in execution across countries.

Required qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Economics, Finance or Business Administration.

Min 5 years of experience in pricing, commercial finance.

Strong proficiency in Excel and comfortable with various simulations.

Problem solving, solution finding and decision making oriented; the candidate has to master navigating through a complex matrix environment with multi-cultural & multi-functional components.

An entrepreneurial / proactive approach is required to design new concepts / processes and successfully drive internal buy-in from all levels of the organization.

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. A Day in the Life

At Medtronic Patient Care Systems (PCS), we power the digital heartbeat behind life-saving cardiac therapies. We build the connected ecosystem that enables clinicians to monitor, manage, and protect millions of patients living with implantable cardiac devices around the world.

From secure device connectivity and real-time data platforms to intelligent clinical tools and patient-facing experiences, PCS transforms complex cardiac data into clarity — helping physicians make faster decisions, improving outcomes, and giving patients greater confidence in their care.

Every line of code we write supports someone’s parent, spouse, child, or friend. Our work ensures that life-saving therapies are not only delivered safely and reliably, but continuously improved through innovation, insight, and global scale.

If you want to build technology that truly matters — where uptime means peace of mind and innovation means more birthdays — join us. Together, we are shaping the future of connected cardiac care and changing lives every single day

Come for a job, stay for a career!

As a Senior Software Engineer within Medtronic Patient Care Systems (PCS), you will join Eagle Eye, the team that turns field data from SmartSync device logs to insight for our connected cardiac care ecosystem. The team works in two areas: an Elastic data platform that ingests, processes, and monitors Smartsync device logs, and Field Investigations, which uses that data to investigate field complaints and issues and their root cause.

You will work across both areas, collaborating with R&D, software engineering quality, complaint handling, and field partners in the US and Ireland to deliver reliable, validated data tools and clear, evidence-based investigation results within a regulated medical device environment.

A Day in The Life Of:

Design, develop, test, and maintain Python data-processing services (Azure Functions) that ingest, parse and analyze SmartSync device logs at scale.

Build and maintain Elastic Stack content on Elastic Cloud, including ingest pipelines, Elastic Common Schema (ECS) mappings, data streams, lifecycle policies, and transforms.

Administer and evolve the Elastic Cloud platform, including version upgrades, capacity and scaling, security roles, and infrastructure as code.

Create Kibana dashboards, alerting rules, and monitoring that track data health, ingestion delay, and issue trend.

Investigate field complaints and issues by analyzing SmartSync logs, implant session data, and device information to determine root cause.

Write clear investigation summaries and reports that support complaint handling, CAPAs, health hazard evaluations, and FDA summary reporting.

Automate recurring investigations with Python scripts and issue detection rules so issues are found earlier and more consistently.

Release and deploy the teams tools through Azure DevOps pipelines and Octopus Deploy, and complete the method validation and documentation required in a regulated environment.

Partner with R&D, quality, complaint handling, and field teams to turn questions from the field into data, tools, and answers.

Mentor and coach engineers, fostering a collaborative, learning focused team environment.

Senior-Level Expectations

Leadership & Influence

Contribute to technical decisions involving data platform design, data quality, investigation tooling, and engineering practices.

Partner with complaint handling, quality, and R&D stakeholders to understand their underlying questions and translate them to practical, maintainable data solutions.

Use technical and investigative judgment to separate signal from noise, and communicate findings, and the confidence in them, clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Provide technical guidance and support to peers, users of the team's dashboards and tools, and project partners.

Collaborate with engineering and quality teams and leadership in a matrixed organization.

Technical Depth & Innovation

Design data pipelines and tools that scale with growing data volumes while protecting data accuracy, completeness, and timeliness.

Evolve data schemas, tools, and dashboards while maintaining compatibility for downstream users, reports, and integrations, and provide migration paths when changes are needed.

Diagnose performance, memory, and reliability issues in data processing, and drive them to root cause with measurable results.

Apply software architecture and design principles to develop reliable and maintainable data services and tool.

Leverage AI tools and agents to support code development, data analysis, investigation summaries, and troubleshooting, applying strong judgment to validate outputs.

Key Skills & Experience Must Have: Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.

Minimum of 4 years of experience in software engineering.

Significant professional experience designing, developing, debugging, and maintaining software across the development lifecycle, using Python or a comparable language.

Experience building data pipelines or analytics on large volumes of log or event data

Preferred Qualifications

While not required familiarity with one or more of the following will provide a strong foundation for success:

Experience with the Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch, Kibana, ingest pipelines, transforms), ideally on Elastic Cloud.

Experience with Elasticsearch query and scripting languages: Query DSL, ES|QL, kibana Query Language (KQL), and Painless

Experience with Microsoft Azure, including Azure Functions and Azure monitor/Application Insights (Kusto Query Language).

Experience with CI/CD and release using Azure Pipelines, Octopus Deploy, and SonarQube.

Experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform.

Experience investigating software issues found in the field and performing root cause analysis from logs and diagnostic data.

Familiarity with complaint handling CAPA, and post-market surveillance processes, and with TrackWise.

Experience validating software tools used in regulated processes

Experience applying AI or large language models to data analysis or reporting.

Familiarity with regulated product development and standards such as ISO 13485, IEC 62304, ISO 14971, and 21 CFR 820.

Experience with Agile methodologies.

Experience using Azure DevOps and/or GitHub.

Strong collaboration, communication, and technical documentation skills

Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life

＜ポジション名＞

Sales RepresentativeⅠ（NV @ Osaka）

＜勤務地＞
大阪

＜部門について＞

脳梗塞やくも膜下出血など、脳卒中の治療に不可欠な製品を扱う部門で、さらに“開頭しない手術”によって患者さんのQOL（quality of life、一人ひとりの生活の質）をサポートしている部門です。足の付け根からカテーテルを挿入し、血管の中から脳の病変部を治療するため、開頭手術と比べ体への負担が少なく、とてもニーズの高い分野です。具体的には、脳血管内に挿入する「塞栓コイル」や「血栓除去用デバイス」、それらを体内で誘導する「カテーテル」などを扱っています。

＜業務内容＞

医療従事者や代理店に対し当社が扱う製品の営業活動を行っていただきます。業務内容には以下が含まれます。

担当製品の営業活動

担当地域の顧客に対する、デモンストレーションや手技サポート

担当地域における販売戦略の策定・実施

会議、研究会、セミナーなど、担当地域におけるイベントの実施

関連する競合のマーケット分析および報告

＜応募資格＞

顧客と誠実な信頼関係を築き、目標達成に向けて継続的な努力が出来る方を求めています。

学士以上

3年以上の営業経験（顧客折衝、目標達成に向けてプロセスを進めた経験）

営業戦略の策定・実践への理解があること

エクセル、ワード、パワーポイントの使用経験

有効な普通自動車運転免許を保有していること

※普通自動車運転免許に関わる行政処分を入社予定日より1年以内に受けていない方

※道路交通法に基づく一定の症状や法規により免許取得や更新ができなくなる可能性がある方については事前にお申し出ください

＜労働条件のうち入社後変更の範囲について＞

従事すべき業務：会社の定める業務

就業場所：会社が指示する管轄エリア

ベネフィット

メドトロニックでは、会社の成功と社員の成長は共にあるべきであると考えています。社員一人ひとりの経済的、身体的、精神的な幸せを高められるような、充実した福利厚生と報酬プログラムを用意しています。

年間最大36万円の育児費用補助

家族に介護が必要になった場合や養子縁組の際などに6週間取得できる休暇制度

ベビーシッターや保育園のマッチングサービス

メンタープログラムやe-learningなどを含むキャリア開発

女性の活躍を支援する社内キャリアネットワーク

自社株購入制度　 etc.

その他

＜諸手当＞

通勤手当、勤務時間外手当、休日勤務手当　etc.

＜休日＞

土曜日、日曜日、祝祭日　etc.

＜休暇＞

年次有給休暇、公傷病休暇、生理休暇、産前産後休暇　etc.

＜勤務時間＞

9：00～17：30

job_description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life
As a Senior Manufacturing Quality Engineer , you will play a key role in ensuring that products are manufactured in compliance with internal quality standards, regulatory requirements, and Medtronic’s commitment to patient safety and product excellence. This position partners closely with Manufacturing, Operations, R&D, and Supply Chain to drive quality improvements and support continuous improvement initiatives on the production floor.

This is a temporary, 1-year contract role responsible for ensuring compliance, quality, and operational excellence throughout the development and manufacturing of Class III medical devices.

Primary Responsibilities:

Maintain and continuously improve the Quality Management System in compliance with ISO 13485, EU MDR, and FDA QSR (21 CFR 820)

Support Operations activities, including manufacturing, validation, MRB, CAPA.

Oversee CAPA, nonconformances, deviations, complaints, risk management, change controls, document control, and training processes.

Actively participate in and support internal and regulatory audits, including preparation, execution, and follow-up.

Collaborate cross-functionally with R&D, Regulatory Affairs, Operations, and Supply Quality teams.

Support production, engineering, validation activities including training, reviewing and approving documentation, work instructions, SOPs , supporting risk assessments, to ensure compliance with regulatory and quality system requirements.

Lead and support investigations of nonconformances, deviations, and CAPAs, including root cause analysis and implementation of corrective and preventive actions.

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, or a related field.

7+ years of QA production experience within the medical device industry.

In-depth knowledge of FDA 21 CFR Part 820, ISO 13485/14971, and EU MDR.

Hands-on experience with ECO’s, nonconformance management, CAPA, and root cause analysis tools.

Strong communication skills in English, both written and verbal.

Preferred Qualifications:

Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement methodologies.

Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional, fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Join a healthcare technology company that alleviates pain, restores health, and extends life for more than two people every second. We are seeking a committed professional to join our team. Cardiac Ablation Solutions offers cardiac mapping and ablation solutions to treat patients with abnormal heart rhythms. Join Medtronic as an EP Mapping Specialist and be at the forefront of transforming lives through advanced medical technology! Various levels available based on qualifications and experience

Provide clinical and technical support and training to physicians and staff on the EP mapping and navigation system and all CAS products.

Educate and train physicians, hospital personnel and office staff on technical matters relating to CAS products and related procedures.

Promote the safe and effective use of Medtronic CAS products and related procedures.

Understand and support national, regional and territory sales objectives to achieve or exceed sales goals within all CAS products.

Develop and cultivate customer relationships resulting in incremental business.

Work in partnership with Account Manager, Regional Manager and Area Directors to identify potential sales opportunities.

Collaborate and strategize with local sales team to conduct customer training for mapping and other CA Solutions products.

Collaborate and communicate with the sales and clinical teams in the region.

Serves as an effective Medtronic CAS representative to physicians and support staff regarding Medtronic CAS products, service and support.

Serve as a regional champion to share your experience and influence others to be proficient in the mapping technology.

Required Qualifications

High school diploma PLUS a minimum of 8 years of related work experience in cardiac mapping and navigation.
OR

Associate degree PLUS a minimum of 6 years of related work experience in cardiac mapping and navigation.
OR

Bachelor degree plus a minimum of 4 years of related work experience in cardiac mapping and navigation.

B.A./B.S. Degree in nursing, cardiovascular, life sciences, or technical discipline with minimum of four years work experience in cardiac field, hospital/clinic or sales.

Proven track record with technical training assignments.

Experience in the cardiac catheter ablation field, EP lab, in a hospital/clinic or EP medical sales providing technical / clinical support.

Ability to travel more than 25% of the time

Additional Job Requirements

Environmental exposure to infectious disease and radiation

Are required to be within their assigned territory each day to be available as unscheduled needs arise

Will on occasion be required to travel outside of their assigned territory and possibility overnight

Must be able to drive approximately 25-50% of the time within assigned territory and may require overnight travel.

Must have a valid driver’s license

Ability to freely move throughout the facility, use a phone, keyboard and mouse, visually able to interact with personal computers

Must be able to stand/sit/walk for 8 hours a day

Must have a valid driver's license and active vehicle insurance policy.  In addition, your driving record will be reviewed and will be considered as part of your application.

Regular employees are those who are not temporary, such as interns. Temporary employees are eligible for paid sick time, as required under applicable state law, and the Employee Stock Purchase Plan. Please note some of the above benefits may not apply to workers in Puerto Rico.

job_description:
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on - 9 Nov 2026

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life
The Acute Care and Monitoring business unit strives to enable earlier diagnosis, better treatment, faster complication-free recovery, and enhanced patient outcomes through Monitoring the respiratory status and Depth of Sedation of patients. Backed by years of exceptional clinical performance and more than 4,500 clinical references, our technologies are trusted worldwide.

We are seeking a committed professional to join our team. While this is a remote position not located at a physical Medtronic site, the candidate hired will be required to reside within the territory and drive to multiple accounts throughout the region. A valid driver's license is essential for this role.

As an Operating Room Sales Representative with our Acute Care and Monitoring business (ACM), you will promote a capital and consumable portfolio that addresses respiratory surgical complications. As a goal-driven Sales Rep, you are the primary person responsible for driving revenue generating sales to key hospital personnel and the end customer. Your primary responsibilities include accurately forecasting your business, owning customer relationships, understanding and targeting customer product needs, and developing and executing the sales strategy around those opportunities.

Bring your sales talents to a leader in medical technology and healthcare solutions. Rooted in our long history of mission-driven innovation, our medical technologies open doors. We support your growth with the training, mentorship, and guidance you need to own your future success. Join us for a career in sales that changes lives.

This position is based in Phoenix, AZ

A Day in The Life

Responsible for driving capital and consumable product portfolio sales that addresses respiratory surgical complications to the Operating Room area of care, as well as the C-Suite level of a hospital.

Lead territory opportunity development and activities that translate to accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual projections.  The Operating Room Sales Specialist will maintain sole ownership of providing accurate forecasts to their Regional Business Manager each reporting period for their territory.

Identify, qualify, prepare, and execute effective sales strategies that maintain the existing base of business and support the close of competitive and revenue growth opportunities.

Probe, develop, and close all related product sales inquiries/leads with existing customers within assigned geographic territory.

Coordinate and collaborate with regionally aligned field sales team to drive incremental RMS revenue and achieve target sales goals.

Develop, negotiate, close, and manage profitable agreements.

Effectively utilize and update sales tools to accurately address trends in existing base of business, create call strategies, and to manage territory and strategic business plans.

Effectively deliver strategic messaging in a variety of settings, including trade shows, presentations, and board meetings

Provide product feature and benefit application consultation, drive value messaging, as well as clinical support.

Lead the local team in the coordination and support of clinical evaluations and pre-sales support.

Conduct post-sales activities, including implementation, product education, in-servicing, and ongoing support.

Maintain and build customer relationships to understand, align, and support customer initiatives.

Maintain detailed level of knowledge of related products and applications.

Maintain a comprehensive understanding of related programs and value-added offerings.

Utilize Specialist and Clinical resources in an efficient and cost-effective manner to optimize sales process

Inform Regional Business Manager and local area team members of new account opportunities.

Complete all assigned projects and administrative duties in a timely manner.

Consistently maintain all Vendor Credentialing requirements

Required Qualifications

High School Diploma (or equivalent) and 6+ years or, Associate’s Degree and 4+ years or, Bachelor’s Degree and 2+ years of relevant sales, clinical, or related experience in medical devices, med tech, healthcare, or life sciences.

Must be located in Phoenix, AZ

Preferred Qualifications

5+ years of sales experience with a Bachelor's degree

2+ years of documented sales success (achievement to quota) in medical capital equipment and/or consumables

2+ years in team selling environment

Experience selling to the acute care hospital operating room environment

Able to quickly compile contracts with supporting financial business case

Proven ability to succeed in complex sales and clinical environments

Strong computer expertise and business application

Thorough understanding of the sales process

Understanding of the medical sales arena

Strong verbal and written communication; exceptional client interaction skills

For Baccalaureate degrees earned outside of the United States, a degree that satisfies the requirements of 8 C.F.R. § 214.2(h)(4)(iii)(A) is required.

Physical Job Requirements

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. For Office Roles: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to be independently mobile. The employee is also required to interact with a computer, and communicate with peers and co-workers. Contact your manager or local HR to understand the Work Conditions and Physical requirements that may be specific to each role.

U.S. Work Authorization & Sponsorship

At Medtronic, we are committed to fostering an environment where employees can thrive and make a meaningful impact. job_description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life.
