A Day in the Life
Join our Medtronic Customer Care organization and help shape the future of customer experience across Western Europe. Customer Care is evolving into a specialist organization where strong customer relationships, proactive communication, cross-functional orchestration and continuous improvement are key to delivering a consistent, personalized and high-quality experience for our customers and business partners.
As an Associate Customer Experience Specialist, you build and strengthen trusted relationships with customers, Sales and Operating Units across the Nordics and/or UK/I markets. You combine customer understanding, strong communication skills and operational knowledge to anticipate customer needs, coordinate solutions and ensure reliable follow-through. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you manage customer inquiries, coordinate the resolution of complex issues and service incidents, and identify opportunities to improve customer experience, processes and digital self-service adoption.
If you enjoy building relationships, solving problems and bringing people together to create solutions, this role offers an opportunity to develop your Customer Experience expertise in an international environment.
Following your full-time onboarding at our Heerlen office, this hybrid position requires 3–4 days of office presence per week. Relocation support is not provided.

Your day focuses on building and strengthening customer relationships across the Nordics and/or UK/I markets. Through regular contact via phone, email and digital channels, you manage customer and Sales inquiries, understand their needs and ensure reliable follow-up. You combine customer understanding, strong communication and operational knowledge to anticipate needs, coordinate solutions and ensure customers experience Medtronic as one connected organization.
You act as a key link between customers and internal teams, using your knowledge of SAP, Customer Care and end-to-end Offer-to-Cash processes to coordinate complex inquiries, patient-critical requests, service incidents and escalations. You work closely with Sales, Operating Units, Order Operations and other functions to ensure clear ownership and timely resolution. You look beyond individual cases, identify recurring issues and work with others to prevent them from happening again.
You proactively identify changing customer needs and opportunities to improve the customer experience. You bring the voice of the customer into internal discussions, using feedback, NPS and operational insights to identify improvement opportunities and work with other teams on sustainable solutions. You also support customers and Sales in adopting new processes, digital tools and self-service solutions by sharing knowledge, explaining changes and gathering feedback to ensure these improvements make it easier to work with Medtronic.

Primary Responsibilities

Build and maintain trusted relationships with assigned customers, Sales and Operating Unit stakeholders through regular, proactive and professional communication, developing a strong understanding of their needs, priorities and ways of working.

Manage and coordinate Customer and Sales inquiries across email, phone and digital channels, including Taxi and Patient-Critical requests, ensuring timely, high-quality responses and consistent follow-through.

Act as an orchestration and escalation point for complex customer matters, service incidents, orders and deviations, coordinating across functions to ensure prioritization, clear ownership and resolution.

Support end-to-end Incident management, including customer complaint intake, cross-functional coordination, root-cause follow-up, preventive actions and closure.

Use customer feedback, NPS/CES and operational insights to identify recurring themes, risks and opportunities to improve the customer and Operating Unit experience.

Proactively monitor customer-impacting operational topics, including disputes, open orders, invoicing, returns and carrier performance, identifying trends and coordinating preventive follow-up with the appropriate teams.

Enable customers and Sales through knowledge sharing, onboarding and change management, actively promoting process adherence, self-service, digital capabilities, touchless processing and standardized ways of working.

Support Customer Information Database gatekeeping by helping ensure data integrity, appropriate governance and adherence to agreed processes.

Contribute customer and market insights to cross-functional initiatives and projects, helping improve customer experience, processes, digital solutions and system design.

Demonstrate strong accountability and ownership by taking responsibility for customer topics, following through on commitments and driving actions to closure, while promoting collaboration, continuous improvement and learning.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

Experience in Customer Care, Customer Experience, Operations or another customer-facing environment.

Fluent in Finnish and English, both written and spoken.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, including active listening, perspective-taking and the ability to build trusted customer and stakeholder relationships.

Strong customer relationship mindset, with the ability to understand needs, influence constructively and support positive Customer and Sales interactions.

Strong accountability and ownership, with reliable follow-through, closure orientation and commitment to results.

Analytical and critical-thinking skills, with a preventive and problem-solving mindset and the ability to recognize underlying issues and trends.

Ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders and priorities, including complex or time-critical customer situations, while maintaining clear communication.

Good understanding of end-to-end Offer-to-Cash processes and operational workflows; experience with SAP and/or Customer Interaction Center (CIC) is an advantage.

Digital fluency, adaptability and curiosity, with an affinity for automation, AI-enabled solutions, self-service and continuous learning.

Preferred Qualifications

Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt, Green Belt or experience with DMAIC or other structured problem-solving and continuous improvement methodologies.

Experience with customer relationship management, Voice of Customer, NPS/CES or customer experience improvement.

Experience with digital customer solutions, self-service or AI-enabled workflows.

A Day in the Life
The HR Business Operations (HRBO) team has a key role in our vision of delivering a frictionless HR experience. The HRBO team:
• Contributes to a world-class employee experience by applying HR best practices effectively and consistently.
• Provides deep business knowledge and HR expertise to HR business partners (HRBPs), enabling them to provide strategic support across the organization. More complex, escalated HR cases, coordinating responses effectively and efficiently.
• Elevates on-demand solutions (like the HR Portal, HR virtual assistant and Workday) as the go-to knowledge resource for HRBPs and their clients.

Do you consider you have the right experience for an HR Business Operations role? If yes, then send us your resume and enter the recruitment process right away! Join Medtronic where we appreciate your talent, experience and passion for your work. You can count on professional and personal development, exciting challenges and a dynamic environment

As a Human Resources Business Operations and dedicated In-Country Resource, you serve as the critical bridge between global strategy and local execution. You will act as the local operational expert, leveraging AI-driven tools to streamline workflows and ensure that HR services are delivered with precision, compliance, and speed.

Primary Responsibilities:

Operational Excellence & AI Integration: Acting as the primary in-country point of contact to establish and maintain operational standards. You will proactively identify opportunities to integrate AI and automation into daily HR tasks, ensuring transactions are processed with high accuracy and programs are administered efficiently.

Continuous Improvement: Collaborating closely with People Connect coordinators and the broader People Solutions team. You will use data analytics and AI insights to drive process improvements, optimizing the information flow between HR Partners and global centers of expertise.

Local Compliance & Case Management: Contributing to the end-to-end lifecycle of in-country HR transactions. You will perform rigorous verification of required documentation and troubleshooting complex processes within Workday and ServiceNow and other Tools. You retain full ownership of escalated cases, ensuring a seamless experience for the end user.

Serving as the definitive resource for HRBPs on country-specific social legislation, employment terms, and local benefits. You will translate global and regional policies into compliant local practices, ensuring Medtronic remains an employer of choice in the region.

Documentation & Local Governance: Maintaining high-integrity digital records and generating localized employment contracts, correspondence, and legal forms. You will ensure all local completion requirements are met while adhering to global scanning and filing standards.

Strategic Project Support: Providing project coordination support for EurAsia Group HR initiatives. You will empower Senior Leaders by providing AI-enhanced reporting and guidance on HR systems (Workday, Recognize, etc.), directing them to self-service tools and documented resources as needed.

Required Qualifications:

Minimum 3 years of experience in HR Business Operations, HR Generalist, or a similar in-country operational role.

Proficiency in leveraging AI tools to enhance productivity and process efficiency.

Knowledge of local labor laws, social legislation, and country-specific HR compliance requirements.

Advanced command of MS Office programs; hands-on experience with Workday or ServiceNow is a distinct advantage.

Excellent interpersonal and time management skills, with the ability to navigate cross-functional teams in a global matrix environment.

Languages: Fluent in English and Dutch (both written and spoken), French would be a benefit.

Preferred Qualifications:

Highly organized with a strong aptitude for detail-oriented paperwork, follow-up, and complex project coordination.

An active listener and team player with effective problem-solving skills and a quality-oriented approach to service delivery.

A Day in the Life

Medtronic Core Labs is building a connected digital ecosystem for surgery - bringing together video, data, collaboration, advanced computing and AI across the surgical journey. The Touch Surgery ecosystem is already used in more than 1,500 operating rooms worldwide, spanning pre-operative learning, intra-operative tele-mentoring and collaboration, surgical video, and AI-powered post-operative insights.

Touch Surgery Aide is our next-generation compute platform for the operating room and a foundation for how that ecosystem continues to evolve.

Aide is more than a platform for real-time AI. It is the on-premise / edge foundation through which digital applications can connect to surgical video, devices, hospital networks and Touch Surgery cloud services - and through which those capabilities can be deployed, operated, updated and supported at scale.

About the Position

Our London Core Labs team builds ambitious products at the intersection of software, embedded systems, connectivity, video, computer vision, AI and medical technology. Product leaders work closely with engineers, designers, clinicians and specialists across Medtronic to create a connected ecosystem for the operating room

As a Senior Principal Product Manager for Touch Surgery Aide, you will shape the product strategy for the digital and edge-compute platform that powers the Touch Surgery ecosystem. You will identify the most important customer and business problems, define the platform capabilities that create leverage across multiple products, and make the trade-offs that determine where we invest.

The role requires a minimum of two days per week in the London, UK office. Occasional travel to customer sites across the US and Europe may also be required, including overnight stays.

Primary Responsibilities

Set and communicate a compelling multi-year product vision for Aide as the intraoperative digital foundation of the Touch Surgery ecosystem.

Define the platform strategy across edge compute, video, data movement, connectivity, application enablement, fleet operations and future extensibility - with real-time AI as one important workload on a broader digital foundation.

Build deep understanding of surgeons, OR teams, hospital IT, service and implementation workflows, customer needs, technology shifts and Medtronic portfolio priorities.

Lead continuous discovery with engineering, design, clinical and field partners; test the riskiest assumptions early and be willing to reshape, defer or stop work when evidence does not support the investment.

Identify which capabilities should be common platform services versus application-specific solutions and prioritise reusable capabilities that reduce duplicated work across the ecosystem.

Partner with Touch Surgery application, AI, cloud and data teams on end-to-end workflows, application lifecycle, platform dependencies, performance needs and release coordination.

Own product direction for connectivity, device-to-cloud workflows, provisioning, configuration, telemetry, software deployment, diagnostics, remote support and fleet lifecycle.

Make explicit trade-offs across customer value, safety, cybersecurity, reliability, usability, technical feasibility, serviceability, cost, scalability, platform reuse, technical debt and obsolescence.

Translate strategy into clear outcomes, initiatives and product requirements with the traceability required in a regulated environment - without prescribing technical solutions owned by engineering.

Work closely with the Product Owner/ System Engineer who translates product strategy into actionable backlogs, acceptance criteria and delivery priorities, while maintaining alignment with engineering on a day-to-day basis.

Partner with Product Marketing, Commercial, Service and Implementation teams to make the platform understandable, launchable, adoptable and supportable in real customer environments.

Required Qualifications

Significant product-management experience with accountability from discovery and strategy through launch, scale and lifecycle, with evidence of measurable outcomes.

Demonstrated success with digital platforms, ecosystems or technically complex products such as edge / cloud systems, integrated hardware-software products, connected devices or enterprise infrastructure.

Strong platform product judgement: you can decide what belongs in a shared platform versus an application or integration, explain difficult trade-offs and show what you deliberately chose not to build.

Strong customer-discovery and analytical skills, using qualitative and quantitative evidence to form product decisions and test assumptions.

Technical fluency sufficient to reason credibly about software, hardware, video, networking, cloud, APIs, data flows, identity and architecture constraints while respecting engineering ownership of technical design.

Ability to operate in ambiguity and influence senior technical, clinical, commercial and business stakeholders without direct authority.

Preferred Qualifications

Medical devices, healthcare software, digital health or another safety-critical / regulated environment.

Operating-room technology, surgical video, clinical workflows or hospital IT environments.

Platform product management, developer / application enablement or multi-product ecosystem strategy.

Edge compute, embedded systems, real-time video processing / streaming, connected devices, computer vision or AI-enabled products.

Device fleet management, remote operations, observability, provisioning, software updates and lifecycle management.

Cloud platforms, APIs, interoperability, distributed systems, networking, identity and device-to-cloud data flows.

Cybersecurity, privacy, reliability, quality systems, design controls or safety-by-design

As Digital Health Director at Medtronic, you'll drive the adoption of innovative connected care solutions across Western Europe, partnering with healthcare leaders to advance digital transformation and improve patient outcomes.

Supporting the Acute Care & Monitoring (ACM) business, you'll lead commercial growth and help bring next-generation digital health innovations to market.

Job Description

The Digital Health Director is responsible for driving the commercial growth, adoption, and strategic positioning of ACM digital health solutions across hospital systems in Western Europe.

This role leads complex enterprise engagements involving clinical, information technology, operational, and executive stakeholders to expand the adoption of connected monitoring ecosystems, software platforms, interoperability solutions, and data-enabled clinical technologies.

The role will also play a key part in supporting the launch and commercialization of new products.

Primary Responsibilities

In this role, you will develop and execute the commercial strategy for digital health, connectivity, analytics, and software-based solutions across targeted health systems and integrated delivery networks in Western Europe.

Additionally you will:

Lead and develop a growing team of talented professionals

Structure, negotiate, and close multi-year strategic partnerships and enterprise agreements that enable sustainable growth across the digital health portfolio.

Serve as a trusted advisor to healthcare leaders, assessing clinical workflows, operational priorities, and digital maturity to align solution recommendations with organizational goals.

Collaborate with clinical, implementation, product, marketing, and technical teams to deliver integrated solutions that combine hardware, software, services, and connectivity capabilities.

Accelerate deployment and utilization within hospital IT environments through interoperability, data integration, and workflow optimization initiatives.

As tech lead, guide collaboration amongst sub-system owners to prioritize tasks and bring the functional design interfaces together

Drive sub-system development workstreams to deliver commitments against timelines and budget.

Strong understanding of Polarion, or similar software, to own documenting technical inputs and design output matrix and artifacts for traceability.

Deep knowledge of standards (IEC 60601, ISO 62304, ANSI C63.27, etc.); accountable for identification of applicable standards and clauses necessary for a product and delegation of functions responsible for executing testing and producing testing reports.

Capture and review schematics, PCBA layouts, and component selection.

Work with 3D CAD assemblies and models within larger system builds.

Engage design enhancement exercises to optimize costs, complexity, and manufacturing time.

Collaborate closely with software, mechanical, electrical, and manufacturing teams to deliver integrated system solutions.

Manage external design/manufacturing partner projects and relationships as an integral function of system design and strategy.

Track progress, risks, and findings across functional sub-systems, organizing formal and informal technical documentation.

Effectuate stage-gating processes for projects within the medical device product lifecycle

Collaborate with broader organization-enabled initiatives on connectivity and AI to craft high-quality products and services that customers love and solve business challenges.

Collaborate with other leaders to ensure successful development, manufacturing, release, and launch of world-class product (portfolio/program).

7+ years' experience in the medical device industry in systems, digital or software development with proven record of accomplishment. Knowledge of Agile methodology is nice to have.

Join our Medtronic Order Operations team and help strengthen how critical operational processes are executed and improved across Western Europe. Our Customer Care Organization is evolving into a specialist organization where process expertise, operational quality, analytical problem solving and continuous improvement are key to delivering reliable and efficient services to our customers and Operating Units.

As an Associate Process Excellence Specialist, you contribute to the execution, monitoring and continuous improvement of end-to-end Offer-to-Cash processes. Working closely with Customer Care teams, Operating Units and cross-functional partners, you ensure consistent process execution, identify operational risks and recurring issues, and support root-cause analysis, standardization and sustainable improvements. You combine operational knowledge with analytical thinking, process discipline and a continuous improvement mindset, while contributing to digitalization, automation, AI-enabled solutions and touchless processing to reduce manual effort and improve efficiency.

If you enjoy understanding how processes work, solving operational challenges and using data to improve performance, this role offers an opportunity to further develop your Process Excellence expertise in an international environment.
Following your full-time onboarding at our Heerlen office, this hybrid position requires 3–4 days of office presence per week. Relocation support is not provided.

Your day involves managing and monitoring operational workflows, open orders, electronic and AI dashboards, and outstanding activities across assigned Offer-to-Cash processes. Using your expertise and understanding of end-to-end operational processes, you ensure accurate, first-time-right execution, identify exceptions and bottlenecks, prioritize activities and maintain process quality, compliance and operational continuity.

A key part of your role is analytical problem solving and root-cause analysis. You investigate complex errors, order processing issues, billing and delivery blocks, and recurring operational challenges. By analyzing operational data, KPI trends and process performance, you identify underlying causes, evaluate potential solutions and support corrective and preventive actions. You collaborate with Customer Care teams, Operating Units, and enabling functions to resolve issues and strengthen process ownership and accountability.

Alongside daily operations, you apply your process knowledge and analytical insights to support continuous improvement, standardization and harmonization across countries. You contribute to process mapping, documentation, knowledge sharing and structured improvement initiatives, including Lean and Six Sigma approaches. You also support the testing and implementation of digitalization, automation, AI-enabled workflows and touchless processing, helping translate operational challenges into sustainable process improvements.

Primary Responsibilities

Own and execute assigned end-to-end order and operational activities across electronic and digital channels, ensuring accuracy, completeness and adherence to defined standards and controls.

Monitor and actively manage operational workflows and open items, including Open Orders, Electronic & AI dashboards, identifying risks, delays, exceptions and bottlenecks and coordinating timely resolution.

Investigate first-time-right issues, SAP errors, billing or delivery blocks and other system or data-related issues, identifying root causes and supporting sustainable corrective and preventive actions.

Drive process adherence, standardization and harmonization by following and improving documented procedures, best practices and consistent ways of working across countries.

Use KPIs, operational data and process insights to analyze quality and performance, detect gaps and trends and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

Apply structured problem-solving and continuous improvement approaches, including Lean / Six Sigma principles, to reduce recurrence, improve process quality and strengthen operational performance.

Contribute to digitalization, automation, AI-enabled solutions and touchless processing by identifying opportunities to reduce manual effort and improve efficiency and scalability.

Coordinate process issue resolution with other Customer Care Teams, Regional Offices and enabling functions, communicating with Customers and Sales when clarification or commercial input is required.

Demonstrate strong process ownership and accountability through disciplined execution, prioritization, reliable follow-through and contribution to cross-functional improvement initiatives.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

Experience in Customer Care, Order Operations, Supply Chain, Process Excellence or another operational environment.

Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

Good understanding of end-to-end Offer-to-Cash processes and operational workflows; experience with SAP and/or Customer Interaction Center (CIC) is an advantage.

Strong process and operational mindset, with attention to quality, process adherence, first-time-right execution and standardized ways of working.

Analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret operational information, identify root causes and distinguish symptoms from underlying process issues.

Experience with or understanding of Lean / Six Sigma, DMAIC or other structured problem-solving and continuous improvement methodologies.

Ability to monitor and prioritize multiple operational topics, identify risks and exceptions and coordinate timely resolution across stakeholders.

Digital fluency and confidence navigating systems and tools, with an affinity for automation, AI-enabled solutions, data and touchless processing.

Strong ownership, adaptability and collaboration skills, with reliable follow-through and the ability to work effectively in a dynamic, international and changing environment.

Lean Six Sigma Yellow or Green Belt certification.

Experience with Process Mining tools such as Celonis.

Experience with Power BI, Power Query or other data visualization and analysis tools.

Experience with automation, AI-enabled workflow solutions or digital process improvement.

We are seeking a highly motivated Finance Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to join our Finance Analytics and Transformation team.

This role sits at the intersection of Finance, Data, Analytics, Automation, and Artificial Intelligence. Unlike a traditional data engineering or analytics role, the Forward Deployed Engineer will work alongside Finance teams to deeply understand business processes, identify high-value opportunities, and rapidly design, deploy, and scale solutions that improve how Finance operates and makes decisions.

The ideal candidate combines strong Finance and business acumen with hands-on technical capabilities. This individual will be comfortable participating in forecasting, planning, performance reviews, management reporting, and other Finance processes while also working directly with data, building analytical solutions, automating workflows, and applying emerging AI capabilities.

The role requires a strong builder mindset: someone who can move from an ambiguous business problem to a working solution, partner with users to iterate quickly, and ultimately transition successful solutions into scalable enterprise capabilities.

At Medtronic, we bring bold ideas forward with speed and decisiveness to put patients first in everything we do. In-person exchanges are invaluable to our work. We’re working a minimum of 4 days a week onsite as part of our commitment to fostering a culture of professional growth and cross-functional collaboration as we work together to engineer the extraordinary.

Key Responsibilities

Embedded Finance Partnership

Partner directly with FP&A, Sales Finance, Business Finance, and other Finance teams to understand business processes, pain points, decision workflows, and analytical needs.

Support core Finance team in key Finance processes such as forecasting, annual operating planning, month-end and quarter-end reviews, performance management, variance analysis, management reporting, and executive decision support.

Translate complex or ambiguous Finance problems into clear data, analytics, automation, and AI use cases.

Serve as a bridge between Finance professionals, Analytics teams, Data Engineering, IT, and enterprise technology teams.

Rapid Solution Development

Design and build rapid prototypes and minimum viable solutions to address high-value Finance problems.

Develop analytical applications, automated workflows, data products, and AI-enabled solutions using technologies such as Python, SQL, Snowflake, Power BI, APIs, and workflow automation platforms. Connect and integrate data from ERP, planning, sales, operational, and enterprise data platforms.

Develop reusable data pipelines, analytical components, APIs, and automation frameworks where appropriate. Rapidly iterate with Finance users based on feedback and demonstrated business value.

Generative AI & Intelligent Automation

Identify Finance processes that can be transformed through Generative AI, machine learning, intelligent automation, or agent-based workflows.

Build and deploy AI-enabled solutions for use cases such as:

Financial analysis and variance explanation

Forecasting and scenario analysis

Management reporting

Executive insight generation

Data reconciliation and validation

Financial commentary generation

Ad-hoc business analysis

Workflow and process automation

Data discovery and natural-language analytics

Decision support

Develop and evaluate prompts, AI agents, retrieval-based solutions, and other GenAI applications using enterprise-approved AI platforms and APIs.

Establish appropriate testing, monitoring, validation, and human-in-the-loop controls for AI-generated outputs.

Data & Analytics Engineering

Work with large and complex Finance and operational datasets to identify patterns, trends, anomalies, and opportunities.

Develop SQL queries, data models, and analytical datasets that enable scalable Finance analytics.

Build analytical models using Python and other modern analytical tools.

Partner with enterprise data teams to improve data availability, quality, lineage, and usability.

Develop dashboards and decision-support tools that translate complex information into actionable business insights.

Scale & Productize

Identify patterns across Finance use cases and convert successful prototypes into reusable solutions, components, or enterprise capabilities.

Partner with Data, Analytics, IT, and Engineering teams to transition prototypes into secure, scalable, production-ready solutions.

Document solution architecture, business logic, data requirements, and operating processes.

Help establish standards and best practices for developing and deploying AI and analytical solutions across Finance.

Measure adoption, business impact, productivity improvement, and financial value delivered by solutions.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor's degree

7+ years of experience across Finance, analytics, data engineering, business intelligence, automation, or related functions.

Strong hands-on proficiency with SQL and experience working with complex enterprise datasets.

Experience with visualization and BI platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.

Experience working directly within or supporting FP&A, Commercial Finance, Corporate Finance, or Business Finance.

Strong understanding of core Finance concepts including financial statements, forecasting, planning, variance analysis, management reporting, and business performance.

Demonstrated ability to translate business problems into technical solutions.

Strong analytical problem-solving skills and ability to operate effectively with ambiguous requirements.

Excellent communication skills with the ability to work with both technical teams and Finance/business leaders.

Experience with enterprise Finance platforms such as SAP, Oracle, Anaplan, Workday, Hyperion, OneStream or similar systems.

Experience building applications or workflows using Generative AI and Large Language Models.

Familiarity with prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, APIs, and modern AI development frameworks.

Experience with workflow automation or low-code platforms such as Power Apps, Power Automate, Alteryx, or similar tools.

Understanding of machine learning, statistical modeling, forecasting, and optimization techniques.

Experience deploying analytics or AI solutions into production environments.

Experience working in a complex global enterprise environment.

Experience with Python for analytics, automation, data manipulation, or application development.

Experience with modern data platforms such as Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, BigQuery, or similar technologies.

This individual will have a strong builder mentality, curiosity about how the business works, and a passion for applying modern technology to solve meaningful Finance problems.

Role Mission

The mission of the Finance Forward Deployed Engineer is simple:

Embed with Finance. Find the highest-value problems. Build solutions quickly. Prove the value. Scale what works.

The role will help accelerate Finance's evolution toward a more predictive, automated, and AI-enabled operating model while enabling Finance professionals to spend more time on insights, decisions, and strategic business partnership.

As a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping our software development lifecycle by designing and building automated test solutions that ensure the reliability, safety, and performance of our embedded and connected hardware platforms used in the operating room. If you are passionate about developing robust automation and elevating product quality through software, we want to hear from you.

Collaborate with software engineers to define test scenarios, testable architectures, and drive quality through code.

Develop, implement and execute advanced test automation strategies for embedded, edge, and device-integrated systems (Android AOSP, Linux-based edge devices, IoT gateways), including validation of device drivers, connectivity modules, and firmware updates.

Analyse requirements and develop comprehensive test plans and protocols for a range of technologies, including service APIs (REST, IPC), WebUI, and over-the-air updates.

Contribute to continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines with automated quality gates.

Generate and maintain technical documentation, standards, and best practices for test, automation and quality engineering.

Collaborate with hardware, firmware, and systems engineers to validate device performance, connectivity, and stability under real-world operating conditions.

Must be able to commute frequently to London-based office; 3~4 days per week onsite.

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent international degree).

Relevant experience in software automation and test development.

Strong proficiency in software development for test automation (Python, Java, or equivalent).

Hands-on experience with manual test management tools and test automation frameworks (Selenium, Appium, Espresso, etc.).

Familiarity with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps).

Device operating systems (Android, Linux).

Service-oriented architecture (SoA), APIs (REST, IPC).

Hands-on experience testing embedded or connected hardware devices, preferably involving edge computing or IoT systems.

Strong understanding of hardware-software interaction, debugging logs, and analysing system-level behaviour.

Familiarity with firmware validation, board bring-up testing, or similar.

Web-based interfaces, Internet-connected devices, OTA updates.

Highly technical, hands-on, and passionate about product quality.

Demonstrated ability to design and implement automated solutions, not just execute manual tests.

Self-starter, autonomous, and able to lead initiatives independently.

Experience with embedded device software development, hardware-in-the-loop testing, device connectivity (USB, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth), and video streaming or imaging devices.

Define and enforce BIOS/UEFI security settings and TPM-based trust chains (Secure Boot, measured boot, TPM attestation)

Implement and manage BitLocker and other Windows encryption mechanisms, including key management and recovery strategies

Build and maintain Windows hardening baselines using Group Policy, AppLocker, custom Shell/UI restrictions, and Kiosk (Assigned Access) mode suited to a clinical, cath-lab environment

Manage user/account permission models and least-privilege access schemes across managed devices

Create, manipulate, and maintain VHD/VHDX-based images for deployment, recovery, and testing workflows

Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps for automated build, test, and deployment of Windows images and configurations

Collaborate with software, QA, and regulatory/quality teams to ensure hardening and deployment practices

Document configurations, scripts, and processes for reproducibility and audit purposes, consistent with medical device quality system requirements

B.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field

4+ years of relevant experience in Windows systems engineering, software engineering, security, or automation

Strong, demonstrable PowerShell scripting skills

Solid understanding of BIOS/UEFI security concepts and TPM (Trusted Platform Module) architecture

Experience with BitLocker and Windows encryption/hardening tools: Group Policy design and management AppLocker rule creation and enforcement Kiosk mode / Assigned Access / custom shell configuration Windows account, group, and permission management

Experience creating and manipulating VHD/VHDX virtual disks (mounting, provisioning, offline servicing, diskpart/DISM)

Strong troubleshooting skills across the Windows boot chain, OS internals, and security stack

Experience with Windows imaging tools (MDT, DISM, Sysprep, WinPE), endpoint security frameworks (CIS benchmarks, DoD STIGs), Intune or other MDM solutions for Windows fleet management, scripting experience beyond PowerShell (Python, C#) for tooling integration, experience working within a large medical device organization (e.g., post-acquisition integration, Medtronic or similar), building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps, Git version control and familiarity with Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban) will be considered an advantage.

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life
Our Automation Platforms team develops and scales reusable technologies that improve safety, quality, and productivity across Medtronic’s global manufacturing network.

We're working onsite 4 days a week as part of our commitment to fostering a culture of professional growth and cross-functional collaboration as we work together to engineer the extraordinary. The person in this role will work from the Medtronic facility located in Fridley, Minnesota.

This role will require 25% of travel to enhance collaboration and ensure successful completion of projects.

The Sr Principal Robotics & AMR Automation Platforms Engineer will serve as the enterprise technical authority for autonomous mobile robotics, collaborative robotics, and emerging intelligent automation technologies, advancing reusable platforms from technology development through factory validation and global deployment.

This role will define technical strategy, platform architectures, roadmaps, standards, and reusable capabilities while partnering with manufacturing sites, engineering teams, IT/OT, suppliers, system integrators, and Medtronic’s Surgical Robotics organization. The successful candidate will combine deep robotics expertise with systems thinking and a platform-first approach to accelerate adoption of advanced robotics and enable scalable replication across applications, product families, and manufacturing sites.

Primary Responsibilities

Serve as the enterprise technical authority for autonomous mobile robots (AMRs), collaborative robots (cobots), mobile manipulators, and emerging intelligent robotics technologies across Medtronic’s global manufacturing network.

Define the long-term technical vision, strategy, roadmaps, platform architectures, and standards for autonomous material movement and flexible robotic automation.

Lead the development and maturation of reusable robotics platforms that reduce deployment cost and implementation time while enabling replication across manufacturing sites and applications.

Architect advanced robotic systems integrating AMRs, cobots, mobile manipulators, machine vision and 3D perception, end-of-arm tooling, safety systems, industrial controls, fleet-management software, and manufacturing IT/OT infrastructure.

Partner with manufacturing sites and cross-functional stakeholders to identify high-value opportunities and lead technology development from feasibility and prototyping through integration, factory validation, and deployment.

Collaborate with Medtronic’s Surgical Robotics organization and other internal robotics experts to leverage technologies, architectures, simulation capabilities, perception and controls expertise, and development practices across Medtronic.

Evaluate and mature emerging technologies including autonomous navigation, AI-enabled perception and manipulation, robotic foundation models, simulation and digital twins, and advanced fleet-management technologies.

Establish robotics platform governance and technical practices for safety, cybersecurity, validation, reliability, and lifecycle management appropriate for regulated manufacturing environments.

Convert learning from factory implementations into standardized designs, architectures, documentation, and deployment methodologies that enable enterprise replication.

Provide technical direction to engineers, manufacturing teams, suppliers, and system integrators; lead technical reviews and resolution of complex multidisciplinary engineering challenges.

Build strategic relationships with robotics suppliers, technology companies, system integrators, research institutions, and other external partners to identify and evaluate technologies that can advance Medtronic manufacturing.

Lead the establishment and ongoing development of an Automation Platforms laboratory for technology development, prototyping, integration, simulation, testing, and demonstration.

Mentor engineers, strengthen organizational robotics capabilities, and represent Manufacturing Technology in enterprise and external robotics forums.

Influence engineering and business leadership through recommendations on robotics strategy, technology investments, technical risk, platform maturity, and long-term manufacturing capabilities.

Required Qualifications ​

10+ years of experience with a bachelor’s degree or 8+ years of experience with an advanced degree

10+ years of experience developing and deploying AMRs, cobots, industrial robots, mobile manipulators, or other advanced automation technologies in production manufacturing environments.

Recognized technical expertise in robotics, autonomous systems, or advanced manufacturing technologies, with demonstrated technical leadership across complex, multidisciplinary programs.

10+ years of experience developing reusable robotics platforms, architectures, standards, or solutions deployed across multiple applications or manufacturing sites.

Experience with AMR fleet management, autonomous navigation, facility and traffic assessment, interoperability, and material-flow optimization.

Experience with advanced robotic manipulation, including force/torque sensing, vision-guided robotics, flexible end-of-arm tooling, or human-robot collaboration.

Knowledge of applicable robotics safety standards and working knowledge of cybersecurity, equipment validation, and lifecycle management in regulated manufacturing environments.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience architecting and integrating robotic systems incorporating machine vision and 3D perception, end-of-arm tooling, safety systems, industrial controls, fleet-management software, and IT/OT systems.

Experience with emerging robotics technologies including AI-enabled perception and manipulation, machine-learning-based motion planning, simulation and digital twins, and robotic foundation models.

Medtronic

At Medtronic, we value what makes you unique. Be part of a company that thinks differently to solve problems, make progress, and deliver meaningful innovations.

Our Purpose

At Medtronic Patient Care Systems (PCS), we power the digital heartbeat behind life-saving cardiac therapies. We build the connected ecosystem that enables clinicians to monitor, manage, and protect millions of patients living with implantable cardiac devices around the world.

From secure device connectivity and real-time data platforms to intelligent clinical tools and patient-facing experiences, PCS transforms complex cardiac data into clarity — helping physicians make faster decisions, improving outcomes, and giving patients greater confidence in their care.

Develop and deliver technical and scientific presentations at customer sites, conferences, and sales meetings.

Build and maintain professional relationships with Interventional Radiologists, Vascular Surgeons, and other healthcare professionals.

Fluency in Dutch and English.

Fluency in French.

A Day in the Life
Cardiac Rhythm Management (CRM) is a core Medtronic business focused on technologies that diagnose, monitor, and treat cardiac rhythm disorders and heart failure. The portfolio includes implantable cardiac monitors, pacemakers, implantable cardioverter defibrillators, cardiac resynchronization therapy devices, and remote monitoring solutions. The CRM team works closely with healthcare professionals to support patient care through clinical expertise, technical support, education, and technology adoption.

As a Technical Consultant within the CRM business, you will support hospitals and healthcare professionals across Antwerp, Limburg, Flemish Brabant and Brussels. This is a remote field-based position requiring regular customer visits and close collaboration with Account Managers, Clinical Specialists, Marketing, and Business Operations teams. Domestic travel of up to 90% is expected.
As a Technical Consultant, you will serve as the clinical and technical expert for the CRM portfolio within your assigned territory. You will partner with healthcare professionals to support device implantation, follow-up care, troubleshooting, and education while helping customers maximize the clinical value of Medtronic technologies.

Primary Responsibilities

Provide clinical and technical support for CRM devices during implants, follow-up procedures, and troubleshooting activities.

Develop and maintain relationships with cardiologists, electrophysiologists, nurses, technicians, and other hospital stakeholders.

Deliver product training and education programs to healthcare professionals and internal colleagues.

Troubleshoot device performance and clinical cases both inside and outside procedure rooms.

Collaborate with Account Managers to identify customer needs and support business growth opportunities.

Support the introduction and adoption of new CRM technologies within assigned accounts.

Coordinate with Sales Representatives and Business Operations teams on inventory, consignment stock, and fixed asset management.

Maintain current knowledge of CRM products, therapies, clinical evidence, and competitive developments.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree OR Master's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Nursing, Technical Nursing, or a related healthcare or engineering discipline with 3+ years of experience in a clinical, technical, or field-based MedTech role.

Min. 3 years experience' supporting healthcare professionals in cardiology, cardiac rhythm management, electrophysiology, or a related clinical specialty.

Fluent Dutch, French and English language skills, both written and verbal.

Experience delivering technical product training and customer education.

Ability to travel extensively within Belgium, up to 90% of working time.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting implantable cardiac devices, cardiac rhythm management therapies, or electrophysiology procedures.

Fluency in French.

Experience troubleshooting medical device technologies in a clinical environment.

Knowledge of hospital inventory management, consignment stock processes, or fixed asset management.

Experience collaborating with commercial teams to support product adoption and customer growth.

Position Summary
The Principal Business Development Specialist will identify, evaluate, develop and advance external innovation and strategic partnership opportunities that can create value for Medtronic in Japan and globally. The role will build trusted relationships across the healthcare innovation ecosystem and serve as a key connector between startups, universities, research institutions, healthcare providers, investors, government organizations and internal Medtronic stakeholders.
This position is expected to contribute beyond opportunity identification. The successful candidate will shape strategy, assess strategic and commercial fit, create compelling business cases, align cross-functional stakeholders and support execution of partnership opportunities, including co-development, commercial collaboration, licensing, investment and potential acquisition pathways. The role requires a highly autonomous, externally oriented professional who can lead complex and ambiguous initiatives from concept through decision and implementation.

Key Responsibilities
External Innovation Scouting and Ecosystem Development

Proactively identify innovative startups, emerging technologies and new business models in medical devices, digital health, artificial intelligence, robotics, diagnostics, therapeutics and adjacent healthcare fields.

Build and maintain a high-quality external network across startups, universities, research institutions, healthcare providers, venture capital and corporate venture capital firms, accelerators, industry associations and government organizations.

Represent Medtronic at industry conferences, startup events, pitch sessions, innovation programs and other ecosystem forums.

Monitor market, technology, customer and competitor developments to identify emerging opportunities and strategic implications for Medtronic.

Opportunity Assessment and Business Case Development

Lead initial assessment of opportunities, including unmet need, technology differentiation, market attractiveness, competitive landscape, business model, development maturity, risks and strategic fit with Medtronic.

Conduct preliminary commercial and business due diligence and coordinate input from technical, clinical, regulatory, legal, finance and business stakeholders.

Develop clear evaluation frameworks, executive summaries, business cases and recommendations to support prioritization and investment decisions.

Translate external innovation into defined value propositions and practical collaboration or commercialization pathways.

Strategic Partnership Development

Cultivate trusted, long-term relationships with external innovators and strategic partners.

Design and advance partnership models such as co-development, commercial collaboration, licensing, strategic investment, research collaboration and other alliances.

Support or lead discussions, negotiations and internal approval processes in partnership with relevant functions.

Help external partners understand Medtronic priorities, decision criteria and evidence requirements, while accurately representing partner capabilities and needs internally.

Internal Stakeholder Engagement and Influence

Partner closely with Medtronic business units and functions, including Global Business Development, Strategy, R&D, Clinical, Regulatory, Health Economics, Legal, Finance, Marketing, Commercial and Operations.

Create alignment among stakeholders with different priorities, risk perspectives and decision timelines.

Prepare and deliver concise, evidence-based recommendations and presentations for senior leaders and decision-making forums.

Act as the primary internal contact for selected opportunities and initiatives, influencing decisions without direct authority.

Portfolio and Project Leadership

Build and manage a transparent pipeline of external innovation and business development opportunities, including prioritization, stage gates, next steps, risks and decision milestones.

Lead complex cross-functional projects from discovery and evaluation through partnership formation and early implementation.

Coordinate workstreams, clarify ownership and maintain momentum across internal and external teams.

Minimum Qualifications
• For Engineer I opportunities, we are looking for a minimum of a Bachelor's Degree, completed by May 2026, with 0+ years of experience.
• Engineer II: Bachelor’s degree + 2 years’ of engineering experience or Master’s degree + 0 years of experience
• Sr Engineer: Bachelor’s degree with a minimum of 4 years’ of engineering experience or a Master’s degree and 2+ years of engineering experience
• Principal Engineer: Bachelor’s degree + a minimum of 7 years’ of engineering experience or a Master’s degree with 5+ years of engineering experience
• We are also recruiting for engineering functional managers, Project / Program Managers, and Distinguished Engineers (Director-level, individual contributor roles).

EMPLOYEE RESOURCE GROUPS
Our Diversity Networks and Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) are building a sense of community, belonging, and activation for Medtronic employees. Medtronic supports diversity networks and ERGs focused in various areas such as gender, ethnicity, age, faith, sexual orientation, military veteran status, disability status and other shared affinities.

HISPANIC LATINO NETWORK (HLN):
The mission of HLN is to provide an environment for all employees to engage and connect with our Hispanic / Latino community by advocating diversity as a key success factor, fostering career development and advancement for all. We will support Medtronic’s GIDE principles and increase awareness about MDT and its Emerging Markets Strategy.

MEDTRONIC OU & PORTFOLIO DESCRIPTIONS

Cardiovascular Portfolio:

Cardiac Ablation Solutions: Cardiac Ablation Solutions offers cardiac mapping and ablation solutions to treat patients with abnormal heart rhythms. Our vision is to help patients worldwide by advancing innovation for the diagnosis and ablation of cardiac arrhythmias, enabling clinicians to perform procedures with superior outcomes.

Cardiac Rhythm Management: Our Cardiac Rhythm Management Integrated Operating Unit offers devices and therapies that treat patients with abnormal heart rhythms and heart failure. We are comprised of four key businesses: Cardiac Pacing Therapies, Defibrillation Solutions, Patient Management, and Procedure Innovations. Together, we will transform the lives of people with cardiac arrhythmias and heart failure.

Cardiac Surgery: Cardiac surgery represents end stage treatment in the care continuum for many cardiovascular diseases and this OU provides an intimate relationship with the Cardiac Surgeon and Cardiac OR by offering an unparalleled depth and breadth of portfolio.

Cardiovascular Diagnostics and Services: Cardiovascular Diagnostics and Services develops advanced technologies to make it possible for doctors to get vital information about their patients' hearts without it interrupting their lives. Our best-in-class insertable cardiac monitors, or ICMs, help identify or rule out heart rhythm disorders, so patients can then receive the right course of treatment and best manage their condition.

Coronary and Renal Denervation: In CRDN, we love what we do. That's because we're passionate about the patients we serve around the globe and the "second life" and improved health we can give to those with Coronary Artery Disease, High Blood Pressure, and other conditions. We're also driven by the promise of Renal Denervation and its potential to change the way patients around the world manage their uncontrolled hypertension.

Mechanical Circulatory Support: The Mechanical Circulatory Support Operating Unit is responsible for Medtronic’s heart pump program. Called the HeartWare™ HVAD™ System, this business provides a left ventricular assist device (LVAD) that helps patients’ hearts pump and increases the amount of blood that circulates through their bodies. The HVAD System features the world's smallest, commercially available, centrifugal flow pump.

Structural Heart and Aortic: The Structural Heart and Aortic integrated operating unit offers minimally-invasive approaches to restore proper structure and function of the heart and the aorta. We focus on the transcatheter replacement or repair of the four heart valves—aortic, pulmonic, mitral, tricuspid—and the placement of stent grafts to treat aneurysms and dissections of the body’s largest artery, the aorta.

Peripheral Vascular Health: Peripheral Vascular Health therapies treat patients with Peripheral and Carotid Artery Disease, End-Stage Renal Disease, Superficial and Deep Venous Diseases, and a variety of conditions treated with Peripheral Embolization. The operating unit leads the way in the Superficial Venous, Deep Venous Stenting, and Drug-Coated Balloon markets, caring for nearly 1 million patients globally with lifesaving and life-enhancing therapies.

Neuroscience Portfolio:

Cranial and Spinal Technologies: Part of the Neuroscience portfolio, CST is comprised of four global businesses: Spine & Biologics, Enabling Technologies, intelligent Data Solutions (iDS), and China Cranial, Spinal, Orthopedics & Technologies.
• Spine & Biologics, offers procedural solutions for spine surgery, and bone grafting solutions for spinal fusion.
• Enabling Technologies, delivers an innovative portfolio which include robotics, navigation, intra-operative imaging, advanced energy devices, cerebral spinal fluid management and critical care.
• intelligent Data Solutions (iDS), with Medicrea as the foundation, is revolutionizing the standard of care for personalized spine surgery using data science and Artificial Intelligence (AI) so all spine surgeons can provide predictable and reproducible patient outcomes.
• China Cranial, Spinal, Orthopedics & Technologies, provides solutions in spine surgery, neurosurgery, surgical synergies, biologics, and orthopedics.

Ear Nose and Throat: The Ear, Nose, and Throat Operating Unit is a global leader and trusted partner for innovative ENT solutions that improve patient access, outcomes, and customer satisfaction. We partner with the ENT community to understand the needs of customers and patients, delivering solutions that improve lives as we embody a culture of accountability and trust. Over the past 20 years, we have become the global market leader in three key segments – image-guided surgery, intraoperative nerve monitoring, and powered surgical instruments. We continue to launch valuable ENT solutions in these areas as well as tissue health and balloon sinus dilation.

Neuromodulation: Medtronic pioneered the field of neuromodulation with the first commercially available spinal cord stimulator to treat chronic pain and engineered the first deep brain stimulation (DBS) system to treat movement disorders and the first implantable drug pump to deliver medication directly to the intrathecal space of the spine. More than 40 years later, we continue to innovate, constantly challenging ourselves to disrupt the markets we created. We advance science by thinking and acting boldly, bringing together the right people with the right breadth of expertise to engineer groundbreaking therapies and technologies.

Neurovascular: The Neurovascular Operating Unit provides a comprehensive portfolio of proven, powerful neurovascular technologies, setting the highest standards of integrity and reliability in Acute Ischemic and Hemorrhagic Stroke Care.

Pelvic Health: Pelvic Health is part of the Neuroscience Portfolio. Our therapies treat patients suffering from overactive bladder, non-obstructive urinary retention and fecal incontinence with our sacral neuromodulation (SNM) systems InterStim X™ and InterStim™ Micro; and our percutaneous tibial neuromodulation (PTNM) system NURO™. More than 400 million people worldwide have incontinence, and many of them limit their lives socially, professionally and personally because of their condition. Our goal is to expand access to our therapies so we can help potentially millions of people get their lives back.

Medical Surgical Portfolio: The Medical Surgical Portfolio strives to enable earlier diagnosis, better treatment, faster complication-free recovery, and enhanced patient outcomes through less invasive surgical solutions.

Gastrointestinal: The Gastrointestinal Operating Unit has created a business out of disrupting the status quo in the detection, prevention, and treatment of gastrointestinal cancers and chronic diseases. We’ve done this by commercializing transformational technologies that improve patient management and standards of care, while increasing access to our innovations across the globe.

Patient Monitoring: Medtronic is working together with the global healthcare community to solve clinically meaningful problems, with technologies and solutions for blood oxygen management, respiratory compromise, and perioperative complications.

Respiratory Interventions: While the global crisis develops daily, our purpose remains the same: To prevent the onset and improve the management of respiratory failure. This guiding principle has enabled us to support patients and clinicians, while creating new opportunities for growth.

Surgical: Our Surgical OU is one new, powerful operating unit bringing together the people and product portfolio of Surgical Innovations and Surgical Robotics. We'll approach the market with a unified approach from concept single strategy, capitalize on our global commercial capabilities, and prove the power of our combined portfolio.

With the Medtronic Mission as our North Star, we will build on our legacy of proven surgical solutions and advance the promise of robotics and digital solutions for the benefit of Medtronic and the customers and patients we serve.

Together, we can change healthcare worldwide. At Medtronic, we push the limits of what technology, therapies and services can do to help alleviate pain, restore health and extend life. We challenge ourselves and each other to make tomorrow better than yesterday. It is what makes this an exciting and rewarding place to be.

We want to accelerate and advance our ability to create meaningful innovations - but we will only succeed with the right people on our team. Let’s work together to address universal healthcare needs and improve patients’ lives. Help us shape the future.

job_description:
At Medtronic you can begin a life-long career of exploration and innovation, while helping champion healthcare access and equity for all. You’ll lead with purpose, breaking down barriers to innovation in a more connected, compassionate world.

A Day in the Life

職務内容

＜ポジション名＞Sales RepresentativeⅡ~Ⅲ (CAS ＠ West Japan）

＜勤務地＞ 応相談

＜部門について＞

心房細動（Atrial Fibrillation, AF）に対して、主にアブレーションと診断の両機能を備えたPulseSelect PFA Loopカテーテルと、パルス電圧を送出するためのPulseSelect PFAジェネレータによって構成されるシステムを展開し、カテーテルアブレーション治療の普及に努めています。

＜業務内容＞

医療従事者や代理店に対し当社が扱う製品の営業活動を行っていただきます。業務内容には以下が含まれます。

担当製品の営業活動

担当地域の顧客に対する、デモンストレーションや手技サポート

担当地域における販売戦略の策定・実施

会議、研究会、セミナーなど、担当地域におけるイベントの実施

関連する競合のマーケット分析および報告

＜応募資格＞

顧客と誠実な信頼関係を築き、目標達成に向けて継続的な努力が出来る方を求めています。

学士以上

3年以上の営業経験（顧客折衝、目標達成に向けてプロセスを進めた経験）

営業戦略の策定・実践への理解があること

エクセル、ワード、パワーポイントの使用経験

有効な普通自動車運転免許を保有していること

※普通自動車運転免許に関わる行政処分を入社予定日より1年以内に受けていない方

※道路交通法に基づく一定の症状や法規により免許取得や更新ができなくなる可能性がある方については事前にお申し出ください

＜労働条件のうち入社後変更の範囲について＞

従事すべき業務：会社の定める業務

就業場所：会社が指示する管轄エリア

ベネフィット

メドトロニックでは、会社の成功と社員の成長は共にあるべきであると考えています。社員一人ひとりの経済的、身体的、精神的な幸せを高められるような、充実した福利厚生と報酬プログラムを用意しています。

年間最大36万円の育児費用補助

家族に介護が必要になった場合や養子縁組の際などに6週間取得できる休暇制度

ベビーシッターや保育園のマッチングサービス

メンタープログラムやe-learningなどを含むキャリア開発

女性の活躍を支援する社内キャリアネットワーク

自社株購入制度　 etc.

その他

＜諸手当＞

通勤手当、勤務時間外手当、休日勤務手当　etc.

＜休日＞

土曜日、日曜日、祝祭日　etc.

＜休暇＞

年次有給休暇、公傷病休暇、生理休暇、産前産後休暇　etc.

＜勤務時間＞

9：00～17：30

Physical Job Requirements

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.

Benefits & Compensation

Medtronic offers a competitive Salary and flexible Benefits Package
A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values. We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help to create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every career and life stage.

About Medtronic

We lead global healthcare technology and boldly attack the most challenging health problems facing humanity by searching out and finding solutions.
Our Mission — to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life — unites a global team of 95,000+ passionate people.
We are engineers at heart— putting ambitious ideas to work to generate real solutions for real people. From the R&D lab, to the factory floor, to the conference room, every one of us experiments, creates, builds, improves and solves. We have the talent, diverse perspectives, and guts to engineer the extraordinary.

Learn more about our business, mission, and our commitment to diversity here
